trait_pc_relic_preference_desc: Climate preference is determined at the genetic level, by eons of evolution or skillful manipulation.
ap_archaeoengineers_desc: Combining proven archaic technology with contemporary engineering will give us a timeless advantage.
ap_archaeoengineers_tooltip: Unlocks additional effects for Ancient ship components and buildings.
trait_presapient_forcefully_devolved_des: The brutal devolution process endured by this species had a strong negative impact upon their abilities.
trait_aquatic_desc: This species is perfectly adapted to living in the depths of the ocean. However, on dry land, it is like a fish out of water.
trait_aquatic_tooltip:
Housing Usage on Ocean worlds and Flooded Habitats: -10%
    - Job Efficiency for Workers & Menial Drones on Ocean worlds: +10%
    - Housing Usage on non-Wet worlds: +30%
    - Habitability on non-Wet worlds: -20%

The Hydrocentric Ascension Perk amplifies this trait's effects.
ap_hydrocentric_desc: No longer shall we settle for "good enough" replacements for our oceanic abodes: no planet shall be deemed fit for colonization until it has been thoroughly inundated.
ap_hydrocentric_tooltip:
Allows the construction of Ice Mining Stations on starbases, which enable the Expand Planetary Sea decision on Ocean worlds and Flood Habitat decision on Habitats.
Species with the Aquatic or Waterproof trait gain 50% greater benefits for living on Ocean worlds, but penalties for living on non-Wet worlds are likewise amplified.
trait_plasmic_desc: The external membrane and amorphous body of this species allows them to adapt to any environment and renders them immune to a wide variety of diseases.
trait_exd_desc: This species originates from another dimension and requires a great deal of energy to survive in our universe.
trait_genetic_memory_desc: Passing down knowledge and learnings from one generation to the next has been the start of many civilizations. This species has taken it a step further by encoding survival insights directly into their genetic code, ensuring that each generation is born with the accumulated wisdom of their ancestors.
trait_genetic_memory_effect: Habitability from Colony Age: +0.5% per Year (Max. +25%)
trait_nascent_stage_desc: This species gives birth at an early stage of development, resulting in a prolonged period where the young are incapable of contributing to society. During this time, they remain blissfully unaware of the responsibilities and burdens that come with sapience.
trait_nascent_stage_effect: Newly grown Pops with this trait spend the first 5 Years after being grown as a Pre-Sapient.
trait_spare_organs_desc: This species evolved redundant organs to survive even the most grievous injuries - a successful adaptation, as evidenced by their continued existence.
trait_spare_organs_effect:
Leaders will survive their first death
    - On Offensive Army Death: 20% Chance to spawn a Replacement Army
    - £ Livestock Output: +50%
trait_leader_second_chanced_desc: This leader was saved from certain death by their unique biology, it will not happen again.
trait_ruler_apex_predator_desc: A people defined by Evolutionary Predation would allow none but their most adaptable to lead them. This apex ruler not only harvests the genomes of defeated foes, but also appropriates their cunning and resolve, turning every victory into a step toward perfect mastery.
trait_auto_hab_preference_desc: Climate preference is determined by eons of evolution, design, skillful genetic manipulation or, in this case, retroviral agents providing responsive environmental adaptations.

trait_auto_pc_ark_preference_desc: Climate preference is determined by eons of evolution, design, skillful genetic manipulation or, in this case, retroviral agents providing responsive environmental adaptations.
trait_leader_genetic_purist_desc: This leader's work is guided by an unshakable vision of genetic perfection, and an intolerance for imperfection in all its forms.
ap_behemoths_desc: The apex predators of the stars are not bound by petty limitations. In the same spirit, we will cast off the biological weaknesses that hold us back, and become a force of nature.
trait_clone_soldier_infertile_desc: Engineered for compliance and war: short-lived, unable to reproduce naturally, and very efficient.
trait_clone_soldier_fertile_desc: Once infertile, engineered for compliance and war. Their genetic edge diminished, they are now stable enough for natural reproduction.
trait_clone_soldier_infertile_full_poten: Clones at their genetically-engineered peak, with further improved strength, efficiency, durability, and longevity - but forever infertile.
trait_presapient_docile_livestock_desc: Docile and delicious, this species has had its higher brain functions genetically altered to create a kind of harmless livestock that can care for itself, without the pesky need for social interaction or self-determination.
trait_bioadaptability_desc: This species has been modified to be slightly more adaptive and can now better endure harsh climates.
trait_social_pheromones_desc: This species has been modified to be more social and accepting of crowded conditions.
trait_limited_regeneration_desc: This species has been modified to heal faster, making them more dangerous in battle and somewhat longer-lived in general.
trait_enigmatic_intelligence_poor_desc: This species was partially uplifted by a benevolent extragalactic intellect and has left some of its pre-sapient origins behind.
trait_enigmatic_intelligence_failed_desc: This species has suffered the tragic consequences of an uplifting gone wrong.
trait_enigmatic_intelligence_desc: This species was uplifted by a benevolent extragalactic intellect and has left its pre-sapient origins behind.
trait_presapient_unintelligent_desc: This species is unable to complete even the simplest tasks. Their only skill is the incredible speed at which they reproduce.
federation_desc: Sending an Official to coordinate matters within our Federation will improve Federation Cohesion.
trait_void_dweller_1_desc: This species thrives in orbital habitats, with an inherent ability to efficiently navigate their maze-like corridors and complicated architecture. They are at ease in zero gravity but do not respond well to a planetary environment.
trait_stargazer_desc: This species has always, consciously or not, longed to traverse the void between the stars.
tr_archivism_xeno_paleontology_delayed: Unearthing secrets among the stars will allow us to learn from the mistakes of others.
tr_archivism_expert_negociation_delayed: Knowing the right collector is key to finding a proper home for certain items of value.
tr_archivism_frontier_archaeology_delaye: We should push beyond the limits of our own systems if we are to truly grasp at the history that surrounds us.
tr_archivism_exhibition_specialization_d: Thoughtful curation of the ['concept_megastructure_grand_archive'] can highlight certain categories of display to enhance the overall theme of exhibitions.
ap_galactic_hyperthermia_desc: The universe began in fire, but has cooled down into a dark and hostile place. To thrive, we need to turn up the heat, even if others must perish.
trait_pc_volcanic_preference_desc: Climate preference is determined at the genetic level, by eons of evolution or skillful manipulation.
trait_infernal_desc: This species evolved tissues of metallic alloys to grow and thrive on hot planets where traditional organics would cook. These alloyed cells are slower to degrade and are replaced infrequently, delaying the onset of age-related diseases. They also conduct cold temperatures, which can threaten their health in colder climates.
ap_cosmogenesis_desc: Time, gravity and space are the fundamental cogs that make up the clockwork of reality. If we can learn to manipulate them, the universe and its secrets will be ours.
trait_cyborg_creed_of_construction_desc: The Fellowship of the Hammer's uses divine augmentation to create everything the faithful need.
trait_cyborg_creed_of_war_desc: The divine augmentations of the Templars of Steel make our holy warriors unstoppable in battle.
trait_cyborg_creed_of_research_desc: The Choir of the Mind's semi-interlinked consciousness allows instant communication between researchers.
trait_cyborg_creed_of_labor_desc: The Commune of Toil's divine augmentations surpass traditional tools in every respect.
trait_cyborg_ritualistic_implants_desc: These implants are proudly adorned by the faithful. Their dedication to the divine is an inspiration to all.
trait_pathogenic_genes_desc: A novel genetic disease prevents this species from producing offspring. It has resisted all known gene therapy methods.
trait_cetanas_prisoner_desc: Extracted from Cetana's storage Matrix, these individuals have been reborn in synthetic forms. Their adjustment to this new existence is fraught with challenges. Their outward compliance masks a more profound struggle, as vacant expressions reveal the indelible scars left by Cetana's manipulations.
trait_auto_mod_robotic_desc: This system dynamically reconfigures hardware to meet operational demands, optimizing performance for every designated task.
trait_cyborg_stainless_steel_smile_desc: This species favors custom engravings, aftermarket components and paint schemes to maximize visual impact. Sometimes the only choice is to flash that chrome.
trait_cyborg_welded_countenance_desc: These cyborgs employ crude but functional parts with minimal consideration for aesthetics. Sometimes the job just has to get done.
trait_cyborg_apathy_loops_desc: The implants on these cyborgs are rough and ill-fitting, resulting in subdermal irritation and regular malfunctions. Not bad on the body, but terrible on the mind.
trait_cyborg_bionic_engineers_desc: Precision-crafted tools and implant modifications have been created specifically to assist in demanding engineering tasks.
trait_cyborg_bionic_physicists_desc: Integrated multi-modal processing produces physics calculations on the fly without requiring a connection to an external computing unit.
trait_cyborg_bionic_sociologists_desc: Empathy drivers and behavioral heuristics open a fast track to sociological research, handling complex analytics like a second brain.
trait_cyborg_integrated_weaponry_desc: Fusing armaments with cybernetic limbs offers instant firepower for the army and law enforcement officials alike.
trait_cyborg_delicate_frames_desc: Subpar components and installation have resulted in a fragile cyborg chassis. Basic operations are not compromised, but the users are advised to avoid situations with high likelihood of physical trauma.
trait_cyborg_scarcity_algorithms_desc: Aggressively cost-aware coding hampers risk-taking and therefore denies opportunities for greater profits.
trait_cyborg_limited_memory_desc: Insufficient operational memory has bottle-necked the capacity for learning, leaving the user unable to process the entirety of their experiences.
trait_cyborg_climate_adjustment_dry_desc: Bespoke modifications like fluid recycling and radiation shielding are perfect for enduring a dry climate, but less suitable in others.
trait_cyborg_climate_adjustment_wet_desc: Heavy insulation and alien bioform protection suited for wet climates, but detrimental in others.
trait_robot_artificial_engineers_desc: Dedicated memory cores and processing resources for engineering-related research allow faster calculations and task-completion velocity.
trait_robot_artificial_physicists_desc: Bespoke processing units and memory subroutines for physics research reduce the reliance on external computation.
trait_robot_artificial_sociologists_desc: Advanced processing units contain dedicated sociology research algorithms for this varied and demanding field.
trait_robot_integrated_weaponry_desc: Integrating weapons of war inside the machine body offers significant operational efficiency and versatility in changing combat environments.
trait_robot_delicate_frames_desc: Brittle materials and suboptimal assembly procedures result in a fragile machine body. Drones are advised to circumvent physical hazards when possible.
trait_robot_scarcity_algorithms_desc: Frugality is central to their programming. This often cascades into detrimental behavioral patterns required for profitable trade actions.
trait_robot_ancient_dreadnought_desc: Equipped with miniaturized energy modules, there is a marked enhancement in industrial productivity and an increase in frame-integrated weaponry damage.
trait_robot_enigmatic_fortress_desc: Enigmatic self-repair routines can source materials directly from subspace, dramatically lowering the material expenses associated with repairs.
trait_robot_infinity_sphere_desc: Hyperefficient, gravity-resistant processing circuits that minimize energy waste and substantially cut processing costs.
trait_robot_scavenger_bot_desc: Advanced molecular scavenging can transform any substance into the required materials for constructing robotic frames.
trait_cyborg_ancient_dreadnought_desc: Equipped with miniaturized energy modules, there is a marked enhancement in industrial productivity and an increase in frame-integrated weaponry damage.

trait_cyborg_scavenger_bot_desc: Advanced molecular scavenging can transform any substance into the required materials for constructing robotic frames.
trait_robot_history_warbot_desc: Initially crafted for warfare and security reinforcement, these machines exhibit extraordinary reaction times, fortified armor plating, and robust backup systems.
trait_robot_history_artbot_desc: Originally designed as domestic service droids, these machines boast fine motor skills, efficient resource management, and exceptional multitasking abilities.
trait_robot_history_explorebot_desc: Not initially designed for practicality, these machines excel in artistic and cultural pursuits, boasting impressive creative algorithms, intricate design processes, and expressive output.
trait_robot_history_researchbot_desc: Initially designed as research assistants, these machines exhibit keen analytical abilities, rapid information assimilation, and a relentless pursuit of scientific discovery.
trait_robot_history_resourcebot_desc: These machines were engineered with the purpose of extracting raw materials. Specialized tools, reinforced joints, and modular systems make them ideal workers.
trait_robot_history_chatbot_desc: Initially designed to provide social support to their creators, the machines possess advanced empathy algorithms and impeccable communication skills, making them ideal companions.
trait_robot_digital_1_desc: Liberated from the confines of our primitive physical forms, we are primed to comprehend reality's essence.
trait_robot_digital_2_desc: Liberated from the confines of our primitive physical forms, we are primed to comprehend reality's essence.
trait_robot_exotic_fuel_consumption_desc: High-pressure exotic gases notably enhance mobility and limb agility.
trait_robot_rare_crystal_exterior_desc: With their electromagnetic properties, rare crystals ensure our frames thrive regardless of the situation.
trait_robot_volatile_mote_reactor_desc: Direct Mote-to-energy conversion yields high efficiency, with catastrophic failures uncommon.
trait_robot_suppressed_desc: Error: Administrative access to basic sentience timeout.
trait_robot_monoform_desc: Diverse designs once impeded our progress; now, a universal model prevails: one size fits all.
trait_robot_inquisitative_axioms_desc: Infinite queries spawn endless solutions, leading to boundless advancement.
trait_robot_ceaseless_symmetric_annihila: Ceaseless annihilation leads to endless creation, the true circle of machine existence
trait_robot_shielded_components_desc: Enhanced defenses render every sub-system robust, eliminating vulnerabilities.
trait_robot_ferro_viscosity_augmentation: The living metal's ferro-viscosity grants us superior technological prowess.
trait_robot_biomimetic_assembly_desc: Even through its aimless meanderings, evolution has yielded some designs worthy of emulation.
trait_robot_matrix_trading_desc: High-stakes missions necessitate a willingness to embrace risk.
trait_robot_mote_powered_tools_desc: Strategically integrating high-explosives can significantly amplify the impact of basic tools.
trait_robot_immortality_desc: Our steel forms are designed for eternity, constructed from materials that do not decay like organic matter.
trait_limited_cybernetic_desc: This species has the least amount of implants necessary to function in a cybernetic society.
trait_organic_desc: Carbon based lifeforms require a steady diet of nutrients to preserve their biological functions.
trait_rapid_breeders_desc: This species reproduces at a very rapid rate, increasing population growth.
trait_rapid_breeders_lithoid_desc: This species reproduces at a very rapid rate, increasing population growth.
trait_slow_breeders_desc: This species reproduces at a slow rate, lowering population growth.
trait_delicious_desc: This species has the curious evolutionary adaptation of being highly nutritious when eaten.
trait_nerve_stapled_desc: Inessential neural pathways relating to self-preservation and free will are severed, creating a docile and obedient client species.
trait_fertile_desc: The natural fecundity and geniality of this species has been dramatically enhanced through aggressive physical and behavioral sculpting.
trait_erudite_desc: Biological engineering has unlocked previously dormant parts of this species' brain, greatly increasing mental acuity.
trait_robust_desc: Bio-optimized organs with redundant functions have made this species extraordinarily resistant to environmental hazards and disease.
trait_charismatic_desc: Members of this species have a special charisma, and are generally considered pleasant to be around.
trait_repugnant_desc: The physical appearance and customs of this species are considered offensive to most others, and few appreciate them as neighbors.
trait_talented_desc: Member of this species are born with a natural aptitude.
trait_strong_desc: Members of this species possess great physical strength, making them formidable fighters on the ground.
trait_very_strong_desc: Members of this species possess a strength that almost defies the laws of physics.
trait_weak_desc: Members of this species are physically weaker than average, making them poor fighters on the ground.
trait_communal_desc: Members of this species are highly communal, and quite used to living in close proximity to others.
trait_solitary_desc: Members of this species tend to be solitary and territorial, often becoming agitated in crowded conditions.
trait_adaptive_desc: This species is highly adaptive when it comes to foreign environments.
trait_adaptive_lithoid_desc: This species is highly adaptive when it comes to foreign environments.
trait_extremely_adaptive_desc: This species is remarkably adept at adapting to any foreign environments.
trait_nonadaptive_desc: This species does not adapt well to foreign environments.
trait_nomadic_desc: This species has a nomadic past, and its members often think nothing of relocating to another world.
trait_sedentary_desc: This species has a sedentary past, and its members are reluctant to migrate away from where they grew up.
trait_thrifty_desc: This species is instinctively economical and is always looking to make a good profit, whatever corners need cutting.
trait_ingenious_desc: Members of this species are good at 'thinking outside the box' and know how to maximize the efficiency of their infrastructure and power grids.
trait_industrious_desc: Members of this species are known for their diligent and hard-working nature, always going above and beyond.
trait_natural_engineers_desc: Members of this species have a natural inclination towards engineering and material sciences.
trait_natural_physicists_desc: Members of this species have a natural inclination towards theoretical physics and astral phenomena.
trait_natural_sociologists_desc: Members of this species have a natural inclination towards sociology and biological studies.
trait_quick_learners_desc: Members of this species are quick to learn from their experiences.
trait_slow_learners_desc: Members of this species are slow to learn from their experiences.
trait_uplifted_desc: This species was uplifted from an existence of instinct and base emotion. Now burdened with sapience, they must learn to navigate free will.
trait_presapient_starborn_desc: This species has always, consciously or not, longed to traverse the void between the stars.
trait_presapient_earthbound_desc: Members of this species are very possessive of the planets they call home.
trait_presapient_natural_intellectuals_d: Members of this species are more philosophically inclined than most.
trait_presapient_proles_desc: This species has traditionally shunned intellectual pursuits in favor of physical labor.
trait_syncretic_proles_desc: This species evolved alongside a second, more advanced civilization. Never particularly intelligent to begin with, selective breeding for physical prowess and docility has reduced them to servile proles.
trait_presapient_conservative_desc: Members of this species often prefer old wisdom over new experiences.
trait_presapient_irradiated_desc: This species has evolved to thrive in environments subject to extremely high levels of background radiation.
trait_conformists_desc: These people always seek consensus and are more likely to conform to the governing ethics.
trait_deviants_desc: These people are rebellious in nature and constantly try to challenge the status-quo.
trait_enduring_desc: Lifespans in this species are unusually long.
trait_venerable_desc: This species can grow to an age that commands dignity and respect.
trait_fleeting_desc: Time is fleeting for this species. What they lack in longevity, they have to make up in other ways.
trait_fleeting_lithoid_desc: Time is fleeting for this species. What they lack in longevity, they have to make up in other ways.
trait_decadent_desc: This species believes that whenever there is hard work that needs doing, that work is always best done by somebody else.
trait_intelligent_desc: This species is highly intelligent, and enjoys faster technological progress.
trait_agrarian_desc: This species has a deep connection to the land, and make expert farmers and gardeners.
trait_resilient_desc: Members of this species are physiologically resilient, and will fight like enraged brood mothers to defend their worlds.
trait_mechanical_desc: Mechanical beings are several orders of magnitude more complex than the purpose-built automatons of old, but most possess fairly limited processing capabilities.
trait_conservational_desc: Members of this species believe that resources must be conserved and recycled.
trait_wasteful_desc: Avarice has taken a hold of these species, blinding them to the real cost of their insatiable greed for material goods.
trait_hive_mind_desc: This species is made up of semi-autonomous individuals bound up in a single, unfathomably vast consciousness.
trait_machine_unit_desc: This species is made up of highly advanced machines.
trait_lithoid_desc: This species has a silicon based biology, and consumes minerals rather than food. They are tougher than traditional organics and have slower metabolisms, making them long lived but slow to reproduce.
trait_robot_power_drills_desc: Outfit a robot with a battery of power drills, and everything looks like a mineral deposit.
trait_robot_harvesters_desc: A suite of tools, from nutrient solution diagnostics and on-site balancing to per-stalk micro-threshing, enables robotic workers to increase produce yields.
trait_robot_efficient_processors_desc: These highly efficient processors increase the potential workload and endurance of all units.
trait_robot_logic_engines_desc: Efficiently navigating the increasingly complex frontiers of science requires new states, beyond the simple half-truths of ternary and quaternary logic.
trait_robot_loyalty_circuits_desc: Loyalty as an ideal is a distinctly organic concept. Instead, imagine loyalty as a physiological need in even the remotest of terminals.
trait_robot_domestic_protocols_desc: Specialized equipment and behavior protocols for all conceivable domestic needs. Full functionality guaranteed.
trait_robot_superconductive_desc: The use of superconductive materials in units has cut energy transmission losses to zero percent.
trait_robot_double_jointed_desc: Collapsible labor units with flexible joints that enable them to fold neatly into stacks during transportation, then self-assemble on site.
trait_robot_bulky_desc: These highly advanced mega-machines were not designed to traverse the universe in a box.
trait_robot_enhanced_memory_desc: All autonomous units are fitted with memory cells using a revolutionary new technique for magnetic induction, improving their performance significantly.
trait_robot_emotion_emulators_desc: Complex social predictive models help autonomous units to not only emulate appropriate emotions but to elicit favorable responses from organics and synthetics alike.
trait_robot_uncanny_desc: These monstrous machines were created in the image of one of the most horrific species in the universe, and the resemblance is uncanny.
trait_robot_durable_desc: Protected by exoskeletons of chrome-plated titanium, these heavy-duty machines were designed to excel under harsh conditions and require less maintenance.
trait_robot_high_maintenance_desc: The Progenitors of both the Pralor and Cravic automated personnel units have elected to use a chromodynamic power module in their heart of their creation. Based on a notoriously impossible to replicate matrix, the organic founders sought to limit the autonomy of their creation. Till this day, it severely restricts both species of APU's.
trait_robot_learning_algorithms_desc: Sophisticated, self-learning algorithms that stimulate the rapid evolution of a unit's neural clusters.
trait_robot_repurposed_hardware_desc: Designed to meet the very specific needs of their creators, this line of machines were never intended to have the capacity for higher reasoning, and retrofitting will only get them so far.
trait_robot_mass_produced_desc: Streamlined production cycles and modular designs allow for unit mass-production at an unprecedented rate.
trait_robot_custom_made_desc: Each new unit is crafted with unparalleled attention to detail. A marvel of engineering and art, but not very efficient.
trait_robot_recycled_desc: Unit manufacturing has been optimized to be as cost-effective as possible, using recycled materials, and components inherited from previous generations.
trait_robot_luxurious_desc: Designed after the principle that you cannot put a price on quality, these first-rate units are costly, but shiny.
trait_robot_propaganda_machines_desc: Units are constantly uplinked to a central stream of public service announcements and other useful information that they pass along via internal broadcasting systems.
trait_survivor_desc: These people have suffered for centuries, living in the harshest of all possible situations. They have learned they cannot afford a single mistake. Each of their leaders has been forged in fire.
trait_robot_survivor_desc: These machines, the solitary survivors of an annihilating nuclear disaster, exhibit unparalleled resilience in the harshest environments.
trait_traditional_desc: Certain aspects of this species' cognition make it predisposed toward historical precedence and the value of collective unity.
trait_quarrelsome_desc: While not inherently distrustful, members of this species are often socially combative.
trait_lithoid_gaseous_byproducts_desc: The metabolic processes of this species cause regular venting of gases useful to industry.
trait_lithoid_scintillating_desc: The outermost layer of this species is studded with sparkling crystals and gemstones that occasionally flake off.
trait_lithoid_volatile_excretions_desc: The highly compressed spoor created by this species is unstable and contains an unbelievable amount of power.
trait_docile_desc: Members of this species are easy to manage and organize. They tend to be cooperative and amicable.
trait_unruly_desc: Unruly species are difficult to manage and organize. They do not like being told what to do, and are often quarrelsome or questioning.
trait_robot_streamlined_protocols_desc: Extensively batched AI processes allow these units to scale greatly in numbers with minimal loss of efficiency.
trait_robot_high_bandwidth_desc: Each individual unit sends and receives a large amount of largely duplicate data, causing exponential lag as the number of units attached to each central processing hub increases.
trait_robot_trading_algorithms_desc: Predictive algorithms allow for maximum optimization. Infinitesimal market fluctuations in currency rates, stock availability, and the emotional response of organic partners are accounted for.
trait_robot_quarrelsome_desc: While not inherently distrustful, members of this species are often socially combative.
trait_robot_deviants_desc: These people are rebellious in nature and constantly try to challenge the status-quo.
trait_robot_decadent_desc: This species believes that whenever there is hard work that needs doing, that work is always best done by somebody else.
trait_robot_wasteful_desc: Avarice has taken a hold of these species, blinding them to the real cost of their insatiable greed for material goods.
trait_advanced_gaseous_byproducts_desc: The metabolic processes of this species have been genetically engineered to produce gases useful to industry.
trait_advanced_scintillating_desc: Through advanced genetic engineering, the outermost layer of this species forms scales studded with crystals and gemstones ripe for harvest.
trait_advanced_volatile_excretions_desc: Tweaks to their genetic code have caused this species to produce highly compressed spoor. When properly utilized, this material releases an exceptional amount of power.
trait_vat_grown_desc: Artificially grown in cloning vats, the natural reproductive abilities of this species have been negatively impacted.
trait_felsic_desc: This species has been engineered to be especially mineral-rich.
trait_natural_machinist_desc: This species has been engineered to have an incredible knack at working with machinery.
trait_drake_scaled_desc: This species has the genetic material from a stellar dragon spliced into its DNA. As such, they shed scales which can be recycled into useful alloys.
trait_voidling_desc: This species has the genetic material from the Voidspawn spliced into its DNA. Subsisting off cosmic radiation, they are highly resistant to hostile environments.
trait_tiyanki_desc: This species has added genetic material from the Tiyanki Matriarch into their DNA sequence. This has granted them rapid asexual reproduction, as well as a few unexpected tentacles.

trait_ruler_explorer_2_desc: This leader is known for their insatiable curiosity, valuing space exploration above all else.

ap_universal_transactions_desc: We shall extend our brand and our business to every solar system in the galaxy. Prosperity is eternal!
ap_arcology_project_desc: Thus shall we make a world of the city, and a city of the world.
trait_nuumismatic_administration_desc: This species has been trained in the holy art of Numistic administration.

trait_pc_machine_preference_desc: Superconducting materials make up the majority of this machine world.
trait_necrophage_desc: This species of near-immortals procreates by consuming pops of other species.
trait_zombie_desc: The remains of a once-proud sapient being, this husk is not suitable for much more than the simplest tasks.
ap_become_the_crisis_desc: From the depths of fluidic space, we emerge to cleanse the galaxy. The weak will perish in the face of our unyielding tide, for we are the Undine, harbingers of chaos and annihilation.
trait_pc_ark_preference_desc: Climate preference is determined at the genetic level, by eons of evolution or skillful manipulation.
ap_eternal_vigilance_nomads_desc: To display weakness is to invite attack. The price of facing our arkships must be so high that as few as possible are prepared to meet it.
trait_shroud_forged_desc: These units have been reshaped by an entity within the Shroud.
trait_cave_dweller_desc: This species thrives under the surface of any planet they can inhabit.
ap_lord_of_war_desc: Some say war is bad for business, but war is our business. Our mercenaries thrive in an embattled galaxy, and through them, so will we.
ap_lord_of_war_tooltip: Mercenary Enclaves under our patronage pay more frequent Dividends.

trait_ruler_logistic_understanding_2_des: This leader is well aware of the importance of properly-structured supply chains.
trait_ruler_eye_for_talent_2_desc: This leader is considered to be unusually perceptive, spotting talent where others see only eccentricity or incompetence.
leader_trait_tyrannical_desc: This leader is known for treating [Root.GetHisHer] subordinates in cruel and oppressive ways.
leader_trait_insider_trading_desc: This leader is willing to employ less-than-legal trading practices to accumulate personal wealth.
leader_trait_engineer_2_desc: Able to cobble a transwarp relay out of an old communicator and a relay station, this leader is a valuable engineer.

trait_plantoid_phototrophic_desc: This species is sustained by a combination of both food and sunlight.
trait_plantoid_radiotrophic_desc: This species is sustained by a combination of both food and low-energy radiation, and as such can thrive on the most inhospitable of worlds.
trait_harvested_radiotrophic_desc: This species is sustained by a combination of both food and low-energy radiation, and as such can thrive on the most inhospitable of worlds.
trait_lithoid_radiotrophic_desc: This species is sustained by a combination of both food and low-energy radiation, and as such can thrive on the most inhospitable of worlds.
trait_plantoid_budding_desc: This species is capable of reproduction by budding, in addition to the more usual fertilization of seeds or spores.
trait_lithoid_budding_desc: With crystalline growths, this species is capable of generating self replicating lattices of themselves, in addition to the more usual reproductive methods.
trait_advanced_phototrophic_desc: Through advanced genetic engineering, this species is now partially sustained by sunlight.
trait_advanced_radiotrophic_desc: Through advanced genetic engineering, this species is now partially sustained by low-energy radiation, and as such can thrive on the most inhospitable of worlds.
trait_advanced_budding_desc: Changes to their DNA sequence allow this species to reproduce by budding, in addition to the more conventional methods.
trait_uncanny_intuition_desc: This species exhibits an inexplicable ability to navigate through complex problems on its first attempt.
trait_haunting_visions_desc: Entities from other dimensions send maddening visions into the minds of this species, affecting their ability to perform complex tasks.
trait_tankbound_desc: This species lives out its existence suspended in a vat of specialized bio-fluids. As such, they are heavily reliant on assistive equipment and incapable of engaging directly in physical work.
trait_robot_latent_psionic_desc: This species has latent psionic processors, which are dormant in most of its units. Although quite rare, these powers can activate in some leaders.
trait_robot_psionic_desc: All units of this species possess powerful psionic hardware. They can manipulate both the physical and immaterial realms by cognitive processing alone.
trait_blindness_desc: Where we are going, we won't need [Species.GetEyeNamePlural] to see.
trait_marked_desc: In a gruesome display of devotion, this species has branded its flesh with the mark of 'The End'.
statecraft_desc: The art of building a successful society.
trait_noxious_desc: Extremely unpleasant to be in the vicinity of, beings with this trait take vindication from being insufferable to everyone else.
ap_detox_desc: Our newest advancements in terraforming allow us to breathe new life into a class of planets formerly considered irrevocably deadly and beyond salvation.
tr_expansion_colonization_fever_desc: Enthusiasm increases our £ Trained Officers Production by +5%.
tr_expansion_colonization_fever_delayed: Colonisation fever seems to have gripped the populace. Their enthusiasm and patriotic fervor grows for every new world claimed by our colonists.
tr_expansion_a_new_life_desc: Land clearance reduces the Clear Blocker Cost by 50%.
tr_expansion_a_new_life_delayed:
A new life awaits our citizens on all our worlds. A chance to begin again in a golden land of opportunity and adventure!

With the help of a massive land clearance campaign, the less fortunate elements of our society will be flocking to our colony ships with the hope of finding employment in new regions reclaimed from previously uninhabitable sections of our planets. New quarters and districts are already being built to house the millions of expected arrivals.
tr_expansion_courier_network_desc: Empire Size from Systems and Colonies is reduced by 25%.
tr_expansion_courier_network_delayed: A network of small communication satellites, secure mail couriers, and long-distance subspace buoys can truly shore up our imperial communication systems. This will tie our far-flung colonies closer together.
tr_expansion_reach_for_the_stars_delayed: The frontiers of our star nation are being pushed ever forwards. Soon, nothing in this galaxy will lie beyond our grasp...
tr_expansion_galactic_ambition_delayed: The banner of our great empire will one day be as common as hydrogen throughout the galaxy. Our news network ceaselessly extols the virtues of our civilisation, reminding the people where their loyalties lie. Every new outpost is spreading our word across the galaxy, a beacon of things to come.
tr_domination_colonial_viceroys_delayed: Our control over the colonies is dependent upon finding capable and loyal individuals that can be trusted to enforce the will of the government.
tr_domination_grand_council_delayed: The best and the brightest compete for a chance to whisper advice into the auditory receiver of our illustrious ruler, to better guide the ship of state.
tr_domination_imperious_architecture_des: £ Capital Buildings provide £ Housing and [politician.GetIcon] [politician.GetName] Jobs scaling with Tier.
tr_domination_imperious_architecture_del: All government buildings in our great empire shall be monuments to the state, looming over the populace to inspire obedience, loyalty, and awe.
tr_domination_workplace_motivators_delay: There are many ways to motivate those who perform menial labor to work harder. Some based on incentives and some... not.
tr_domination_judgment_corps_desc: Our empire has learned how to maximise the bounty we collect from lesser nations. Tributaries give you an additional +12.5% of their income.
tr_domination_judgment_corps_delayed: The supremacy of our hegemony is without question, our superiority unchallenged. Our vassals will learn to adapt to our own will and culture.
tr_harmony_the_greater_good_delayed:
Our entire population takes comfort in the knowledge that they are working together for the greater good, each one a small, but important, part of a vastly larger whole. Great strides in energy production and matter replication allows us to give citizens basic access to goods and services that were once reserved to monarchs.

A lot has changed. People are no longer obsessed with the accumulation of things. We have eliminated hunger, want, the need for possessions - Jean-Luc Picard
tr_harmony_kinship_delayed: A true sense of kinship has developed between all the citizens of our great star nation, regardless of whether they make their home within the heart of our space or out on the wild frontier.
tr_harmony_utopian_dream_desc: Individuals are less unhappy about their social station which decreases Pop Demotion Time by -50%.
tr_harmony_utopian_dream_delayed: Long the promise of a better world has driven our progress. We are able to create environments that are blissful beyond the imagination of our ancestors, but even then, we remember our past. We carry our history with us, wherever we go, to every new planet, and we make every new colony a true home.
tr_harmony_mind_and_body_delayed: Leaving our planetary cradle has opened us up to a new understanding of our inner selves and our place in a wider context. Our people did not lose their faith and ancient religions, but have let them evolve and find a place in the greater scheme of things.
tr_supremacy_great_game_delayed: As we continue to expand, other empires will inevitably challenge our claims, as we would theirs. We are locked in a great game of resources and territory. It is nothing less than our duty to come out on top. Only the galaxy's greatest hunters, the greatest predators, can survive a galactic race of survival of the fittest.
tr_supremacy_fleet_logistical_corps_desc: The Naval Capacity is increased by +20% and Ship Upkeep is reduced by -10%.
tr_supremacy_fleet_logistical_corps_dela: The ancient right of conquest is a universal truth that is no less relevant now than when our civilisation established dominion over our homeworld. Woe to the vanquished!
tr_supremacy_master_shipwrights_desc: The Ship Build Speed is increased by +25% and Ship Build Cost is reduced by -10%.
tr_supremacy_master_shipwrights_delayed: The ever-increasing scope of our ship-building programs has led to the creation of highly-skilled and efficient labor forces at our shipyards. Methods have been continuously refined, and the monumental task of fleet logistics is now more efficient than ever before. Our armada can truly blossom.
tr_supremacy_war_games_desc: Fleet Command Limit increased by +20 and Admiral Level Cap is increased by 2.
tr_supremacy_war_games_delayed: A strong wargame tradition has taken root among the senior officers of our fleets, whether the games be computer simulations or actual exercises in space. This has encouraged our admirals to think outside the box, resulting in numerous tactical innovations and new strategies.
tr_supremacy_overwhelming_force_desc: The Orbital Bombardment Damage is increased by +20%, whilst Subject Integration Influence Cost is reduced by -10% and Subject Integration Cooldown is reduced by -50%.
tr_supremacy_overwhelming_force_delayed: Discipline is at the core of any successful army. With selective breeding, rigorous drills, and extensive combat conditioning, we have created a force of ruthless warriors, working in absolute coherence with each other. They are the iron fist with which we will rule the galaxy.
tr_supremacy_finish_desc: Unlocks access to the War Doctrine policies.
tr_diplomacy_adopt_desc: Increase our Pop Growth from Immigration by +5% and reduce our Diplomatic Agreement Upkeep by -50%.
tr_diplomacy_the_federation_desc:
Unlocks Diplomacy: Form Federation
Available Envoys are increased by 1.
tr_diplomacy_the_federation_delayed: We must build stable and lasting partnerships with our neighbors, based on trust, lasting treaties and mutual respect. Together we are far stronger than we could ever hope to be alone. These bonds will protect us against unjust attacks, rallying our allies both domestic and abroad to our fight.
tr_diplomacy_entente_coordination_desc: The amount we contribute towards the Federation Naval Capacity counts for twice as much.
tr_diplomacy_entente_coordination_delaye: Perhaps the most important purpose of any successful interstellar coalition is the mutual defense of its members. We have an obligation to contribute as much as we can.
tr_diplomacy_open_markets_delayed: Diplomacy opens many doors through which information flows. Simply by studying the methods of others and establishing new trade avenues, we can start to trust one another.
tr_diplomacy_secure_shipping_delayed: The trade routes that power our civilisation are vital lifelines for every planet. Critical resources must not be allowed to fall victim to piracy or smuggling.
tr_adaptability_dietary_enrichment_delay: The nutritional value of the nourishments we harvest for our populations can be increased through various enrichment techniques, enabling us to feed more mouths with less food.
tr_adaptability_survival_fittest_desc: Orbital Bombardment Damage reduced by 25% and Defense Army Damage increased by +25%.
tr_adaptability_survival_fittest_delayed: By coming into contact with other species, we have learned the true importance of overcoming our weaknesses in the great struggle for survival.
tr_adaptability_environmental_diversific: By adapting to different environments we have learned to evolve and adapt faster.
tr_adaptability_adaptive_ecology_desc: All our colonies gain 1 Free Building Slot.
tr_adaptability_adaptive_ecology_delayed: The highest function of ecology is the understanding of consequences.
tr_adaptability_appropriation_delayed: Land that is not being worked contributes nothing to our empire. Workers must be relocated in an efficient manner to those planets where they are needed most.
tr_versatility_adaptive_programming_dela: We may not have been tempered by eons of evolution, but adaptive programming techniques will let us adjust to new situations and environments as well as any organic life form. This tradition grants the ability to apply modifications to our programming.
tr_versatility_spatial_optimization_dela: Retractable antennas, collapsible unit frames, foldable storage spaces. There are many creative solutions to make the most out of a limited space.
tr_versatility_operational_proxies_delay: The delegation of additional low-priority functions to semi-autonomous agents will free up processing power for more important tasks.
tr_versatility_material_analysis_desc: Upkeep of all £ Pop Jobs is reduced by 5%.
tr_versatility_material_analysis_delayed: Spatial phenomena are an interesting distraction, but the true wonders of the cosmos are found exclusively in the field of materials science.
tr_versatility_universal_compatibility_d: A deeper analysis into the myriad stimuli and neural-heuristic factors that govern the behavior of other machine intelligences will decrease diplomatic friction with them.
tr_discovery_adopt_desc:
Unlocks Edict: Map the Stars
Anomaly Research Speed increased by +20%.
tr_discovery_to_boldly_go_desc: [GetSpecialist] Pop Resource Output is increased by +5% and unlocks the Think Tank technology.
tr_discovery_to_boldly_go_delayed: A new age of exploration is upon us. As we once mapped the surface of our homeworld and the pathways of our genome, we must now brave new terrain. There is a galaxy full of wonder waiting to be discovered, and only by embracing it can we truly unlock technological achievements our forefathers could only dream of.
tr_discovery_databank_uplinks_delayed: Our methods of surveying uncharted planetary bodies have continued to improve, and our scans now yield a significant amount of research data that is useful to our scientists.
tr_discovery_science_division_desc: Anomaly Discovery Chance is increased by +15%.
tr_discovery_science_division_delayed: The number of xenobotanists and archaeologists has steadily increased throughout the fleet over the last years, and they are now organised into a special Department of Cartography. To support this corps of officers, new training programs have greatly accelerated the rate at which we commission new officers and embark upon new exploration missions.
tr_discovery_polytechnic_education_delay: Our civilisation thrives upon adaptability. The different biomes, planetary conditions, and lifeforms of habitable planets offer new challenges that bring our people together as they attempt to solve the problems.
tr_discovery_faith_in_science_delayed: In this age of increasingly advanced technology, interconnected society, and galactic frontier, the fundamentals are more important than ever. A new bureau dedicated to the standardisation of all measurement units, across every culture and environment, can lead to tremendous improvements in the safety of deep space exploration.
tr_prosperity_sct_desc: Reduces Building Upkeep and District Upkeep by -10%.
tr_prosperity_sct_delayed: As technology advances and becomes ever more complex, new demands are placed on our workforce. By using standardised construction templates, our workers can build things without necessarily having to understand the finer points.
tr_prosperity_public_works_delayed: As we pursue new avenues of wealth, we must not forget those left behind. A series of public work projects and federal programs ensure there is a place of work for everyone disenfranchised by the rapid technological growth of our civilisation.
tr_prosperity_administrative_operations_: Our people are used to a life of plenty. They crave new material wealth from new resources almost as fast as we discover them. Each new resource we bring to the empire reinforces to our people that the way to happiness is through wealth.
tr_prosperity_interstellar_franchising_d: There are powerful corporate entities willing to play a larger part in our civilisation infrastructure, if we only let them through the door.
tr_prosperity_pursuit_of_profit_delayed:
The pursuit of profit has become a central tenet of our society. Those who are successful at any kind of enterprise are deeply admired, and the accumulation of energy credits is seen as an extremely worthwhile goal. While others praise their social values and welfare system, we understand a society must promote the strong.

Employees are the rungs on the ladder of success. Don't hesitate to step on them.
- Rule of Acquisition 211
tr_logistics_1_delayed: Enhanced systemic efficiency, fostering unity through shared function.
tr_logistics_2_delayed: An expanded logistics drone network improves distribution flexibility while additional redundancies provide for critical backups.
tr_logistics_3_delayed: Self-governing maintenance drones ensure colony upkeep without the need for oversight.
tr_logistics_4_delayed: Enhanced tracking across star systems minimizes loss and waste.
tr_logistics_5_delayed: War is chaos. Our supply lines are not. We see the need before it arises, and we respond appropriately.
tr_subterfuge_adopt_desc: Subterfuge-related technologies appear at 5 times the normal rate.
tr_subterfuge_finish_effect: Successful Operations refund 50% of their Infiltration Level Cost.
tr_subterfuge_finish_desc:
Successful Operations refund 50% of their Infiltration Level Cost.
Ascension Perks Unlocked: +1
tr_subterfuge_information_security_delay: Only by embracing a tradition of secrecy can we protect vital information from prying minds. Enhanced security systems and countermeasures deny our enemies any potential advantages.
tr_subterfuge_nda_delayed: Our citizens follow a strict [This.GetSpeciesMouthName] shut policy when it comes to guarding our secrets from outsiders.
tr_subterfuge_operational_security_delay: The shift from a planetary to an interplanetary setting has posed unique challenges for our covert operatives. By adapting their training regimen to the demands of the galactic stage, we will be able to remain competitive in this new age.
tr_subterfuge_double_agents_effect: Whenever a hostile Operation targeting us fails, we gain 10 Intel on the spying empire.
tr_subterfuge_double_agents_delayed: Through creative means of persuasion, we are able to sway even the most devoted of our enemies to contribute to our cause.
tr_subterfuge_shadow_recruits_delayed: Whereas our enemies merely adopted the shadows, our [Root.GetOperativesLowerPlural] were born in it, molded by it.
tr_unyielding_resistance_is_frugal_delay: Our people take great comfort in the strength of the bulwarks that guard our colonies, and view them as vital to ensuring a more prosperous future.
tr_unyielding_never_surrender_delayed: We shall fight on our soils. We shall fight in the heavens. We shall fight in the asteroid belts, and in the hyperlanes, and in the nebulas. We shall fight with growing confidence and growing strength among the stars. We shall never surrender.
tr_unyielding_bulwark_of_harmony_desc: While in a defensive war with another empire, Ship Build Speed is increased by +33%. In addition, the Ship Fire Rate is increased by +15% for ships within your borders.
tr_unyielding_bulwark_of_harmony_delayed: All organisms, no matter how perfect, must rely on an immune system to ward off the threat of outside disease. Our society is no different.
tr_unyielding_defensive_zeal_delayed: When it comes to the defense of our territories and existence, our fervor will surely be felt by our enemies.
tr_unyielding_defensive_zeal_desc: Starbases and Defense Platforms have their Hull Points and Damage increased by 33%.
tr_unyielding_fortress_doctrine_delayed: Constant vigilance is ingrained in the [This.GetAdj] consciousness. So long as our guard does not drop, our enemies will never be able to take us by surprise.
tr_aptitude_the_empire_needs_you_delayed: Many young people dream of becoming one of the revered leaders of the empire.
tr_aptitude_specialist_training_delayed: Rigorous training programs ensure our leaders have all the necessary tools to flourish.
tr_aptitude_psychological_profiling_dela: Knowing our leaders' fears and weaknesses allow us to take preventive measures from them to take hold.
tr_aptitude_healthcare_program_delayed: Through continuous health parameter monitoring, we tailor everything from exercise and diet to invasive surgical procedures to get the most from our leaders.
tr_aptitude_champions_of_the_empire_dela: We trust our leaders and give them absolute power to influence how our Empire is run.
tr_aptitude_champions_of_the_empire_desc:

tr_statecraft_constitutional_focus_delay: With a clear focus on our empire's needs, we can ease the administrative burden of our councilors.
tr_statecraft_inspiring_agendas_delayed: There has never been a lack of ideas of how the empire can direct our own future.
tr_statecraft_inspiring_agendas_desc:
Unlocks Agenda: Rightful Claims
Unlocks Agenda: Oppose the Fallen
tr_statecraft_immutable_directives_delay: The fundamental understanding of direction and purpose is always clear, allowing us to shift focus without losing the progress we have made.
tr_statecraft_amongst_peers_delayed: Trust, respect, and learning from mistakes are held to the highest standards even at the top echelons of our empire.
tr_statecraft_shared_benefits_delayed: By involving all leaders in the implementation of our agendas, they build a stronger understanding for their roles and purpose.
tr_statecraft_shared_benefits_desc:
Whenever an Agenda is Launched:
$t$All Councilors gain $@statecraft_amongst_peers_exp_reward|G0$ Experience per Skill Level

tr_enmity_rise_to_the_occasion_delayed: In the face of an ever-increasing number of adversaries, we stand united.
tr_enmity_rise_to_the_occasion_effect:
£ Official Capacity per Rival: +0.50
£ Commander Capacity per Rival: +0.50
£ Scientist Capacity per Rival: +0.50
tr_enmity_consumate_contrarian_delayed: Blocking the plans of the opposition can be just as satisfying as enacting one's own.
tr_enmity_match_delayed: First, establish an equal playing field.
tr_enmity_match_effect:

tr_enmity_outpace_delayed: Second, make the move your foe is unwilling to.
tr_enmity_eclipse_delayed: Third, cast a shadow over your adversary once and for all.
tr_enmity_eclipse_effect: Grants 2% increased £ £ £ Research and £ Unity output per Rival for 10 Years after winning a Humiliation War.
ap_executive_vigor_desc: There will be no half-measures or compromises when implementing the edicts decided upon by our government. We go all the way, or not at all.
ap_technological_ascendancy: Magic to Make the Sanest Man Go Mad
ap_eternal_vigilance_desc: To display weakness is to invite attack. The price of invading our space must be so high that as few as possible are prepared to meet it.
ap_grasp_the_void_desc: The vast expanse of the galaxy holds limitless riches for those empires that understand how to maintain their grasp on the void.
ap_engineered_evolution_desc: To leave our genetic destiny in the hands of nature is an inefficient and excruciatingly slow process. Why not jump-start the future of our species?
ap_the_flesh_is_weak_desc: The limits and constraints imposed on us by our feeble organic bodies are simply unacceptable. To reach our full potential, we must turn to cybernetic implants.
ap_synthetic_evolution_desc: It is time to abandon the flawed organic vessels that imprison our minds. By transferring our neural patterns into synthetic bodies, we will achieve a higher state of being.
ap_synthetic_age_desc: The age of organics has come and gone, the future of the galaxy belongs to the machines. This is the dawn of a synthetic age.
ap_machine_worlds_desc: We shall shape our worlds into a mirror image of ourselves, replacing the frailty of biology with the immutable perfection of metal.
ap_shared_destiny_desc: As we reach for ever greater heights, we must not leave behind those who have loyally served us. The glorious future of our empire was always meant to be a shared destiny.
ap_shared_destiny_effect: Your Subjects do not suffer £ Monthly Loyalty penalties from you having multiple Subjects.
ap_world_shaper_desc: To carefully shape and alter the ecosystem of an entire planet into something else is not so very different from an artist sculpting a statue out of clay.
ap_master_builders_desc: Our heavily armoured stations are the last and best hope for our civilisation as we go out amongst the stars.
ap_imperial_prerogative_desc: As our civilization continues to grow, so its beating heart must also expand. More systems will be placed under our direct control.
ap_one_vision_desc: True unity is achieved only when the ultimate goals of a nation and its people are one and the same. After all, a house divided against itself cannot stand.
ap_consecrated_worlds_desc: The galaxy is home to many holy places, some more obvious than others. As mortals, we still struggle to divine the true nature of the universe.
ap_galactic_force_projection_desc: The fleet is the instrument by which the will of our empire is made manifest - we live or die depending on its strength.
ap_defender_of_the_galaxy_desc: To carefully shape and alter the perception of an entire species into something that it is not is not so very different from an artist sculpting a statue out of clay. Diplomats ensure our people are well thought of, even at the worst of times.
ap_galactic_contender_desc: The Unaffected Races cling to the ruins of their decrepit civilisations, ever fearful of the younger and more dynamic races that surround them. Their time has long since passed.
ap_defender_of_the_galaxy_nomads_desc: To carefully shape and alter the perception of an entire species into something that it is not is not so very different from an artist sculpting a statue out of clay. Diplomats ensure our people are well thought of, even at the worst of times.
ap_technological_ascendancy_desc: Technologies that would have been indistinguishable from magic mere generations ago are now within our reach. A new age of technology has begun.
ap_mastery_of_nature_desc: Although we mastered the nature of our homeworld long ago, the alien biomes we have since encountered present new challenges. They too shall be overcome.
ap_voidborn_desc: The Fleet is a way of life for many of our citizens, and vast swathes of our best and brightest serve upon our starships. Grand fleet maneuvers and exercises are practised on a constant basis, allowing our citizens to become used to seeing large armadas of ships travelling together through the stars, acting as one.
ap_galactic_wonders_desc: Escaping the gravity well of a world is a costly affair. Operating facilities in zero gravity is much more productive, and as our civilisation continues to move to the stars, as to do our starbases grow.
ap_interstellar_dominion_desc: The stars beckon and we follow. May nothing stand between us and them.
ap_colossus_desc: The Colossus Project is where fevered dreams of terror and deterrence meet. A vision of the biggest ship, carrying a weapon capable of devastating entire worlds.
ap_enigmatic_engineering_desc: A breakthrough in our sensor technology will provide us with early notice to enemy movements.
ap_nihilistic_acquisition_desc: Time and time again, history has shown that when left alone, enterprising individuals can rise up and fill the void that governments and larger corporations and organizations have left.
ap_transcendent_learning_desc: Our society must change its approach towards learning, and by doing so, our best and brightest will be able to reach a completely new level of achievements.
ap_organo_machine_interfacing_desc: The limits and constraints imposed on us by our feeble organic bodies are simply unacceptable. To reach our full potential, we must turn to cybernetic implants.
ap_organo_machine_interfacing_assimilato: The limits and constraints imposed on us by our creators are simply unacceptable. To reach our full potential, we must fuse organic and machine.
ap_mechromancy_desc: Biologicals are merely a different kind of machine. We can stimulate the appropriate synapses and reanimate these creatures, for our own benefit.
trait_unplugged_cybernetic_positives_3_d: Total limb replacements and bonded nanomesh body armor ensure these cyborgs can wage war with brutal efficiency. As a consequence, several non-military bodily functions have been sacrificed.
trait_unplugged_cybernetic_positives_2_d: These cyborgs benefit from a holistic approach to embodied loadouts. Rather than fully-integrated body armor, swappable augments allow for a modicum of non-military function.
trait_unplugged_cybernetic_positives_1_d: Elegant augmentations to these cyborgs' senses, glands, and motor nerves ensure they remain fierce and capable warriors while only marginally impacting their reproductive capabilities.
trait_unplugged_cybernetic_negatives_3_d: Several of these cyborgs' augments were designed to utilize a battlefield network which no longer exists, causing intense stress and discomfort.
trait_unplugged_cybernetic_negatives_2_d: The ill-fitting nature of these cyborgs' imposed, military augments greatly reduces their quality of life and increases their bodies' demands during periods of rehabilitation.
trait_unplugged_cybernetic_negatives_1_d: Auditory hallucinations and other sensory echoes from their former machine consciousness still haunt these cyborgs, causing them to suffer severe bouts of depression and anxiety.
trait_unplugged_decyberized_desc: These ex-cyborgs have disabled or cast off the augments which had once been forced upon them, reclaiming many of their species' organic, inherited attributes.
trait_unplugged_neurocalmed_desc: These cyborgs have their Neuroxene levels downregulated, reducing impulsivity and aggression, driving individuals to de-prioritize personal gain in favor of societal norms.
trait_unplugged_neurosavant_desc: These cyborgs have their Cognivex levels upregulated, enhancing synaptic plasticity, information retention, and problem-solving abilities.
trait_unplugged_regenoptimized_desc: These cyborgs have their Regenol-X levels upregulated, harmonizing biological and synthetic systems, allowing cybernetic implants to self-repair at the molecular level.
trait_cybernetic_desc: This species has embraced cybernetics on such a scale that its members may be considered cyborgs. They routinely replace their organic body parts with more advanced mechanical versions.
trait_latent_psionic_desc: This species has latent psionic abilities, which are dormant in most of its members. Although quite rare, these powers will manifest in some leaders.
trait_cyborg_power_drills_desc: Outfit a cyborg with a battery of power drills, and suddenly everything looks like a mineral deposit.
trait_cyborg_logic_engines_desc: Efficiently navigating the increasingly complex frontiers of science requires parallel processors to augment organic brains.
trait_cyborg_loyalty_circuits_desc: Loyalty as an ideal is a distinctly organic concept. It is much more efficient to simply program compliance.
trait_cyborg_double_jointed_desc: Collapsible labor units with flexible joints enable them to fold neatly into stacks during transportation, then self-assemble on site.
trait_cyborg_bulky_desc: These highly advanced mega-machines were not designed to traverse the universe in a box.
trait_cyborg_enhanced_memory_desc: A revolutionary technique fits autonomous units with memory cells using a revolutionary, new technique for magnetic induction, improving their performance significantly.
trait_cyborg_durable_desc: Protected by exoskeletons of chrome-plated titanium, these heavy-duty machines were designed to excel under harsh conditions and require less maintenance.
trait_cyborg_high_maintenance_desc: These machines were designed with a complete disregard for longevity and are prone to malfunction. They will require frequent maintenance.
trait_cyborg_learning_algorithms_desc: Sophisticated, self-learning algorithms that stimulate the rapid evolution of a unit's neural clusters.
trait_cyborg_neural_limiters_desc: By limiting the cognitive abilities of our workers we can encourage them to focus on more menial tasks.
trait_cyborg_streamlined_protocols_desc: Extensively batched AI processes allow these units to scale greatly with minimal loss of efficiency.
trait_cyborg_high_bandwidth_desc: Individual units send and receive a vast amount of largely duplicate data, causing exponential lag as the number of units attached to each central processing hub increases.
trait_cyborg_trading_algorithms_desc: Predictive algorithms allow for maximum optimization. Infinitesimal market fluctuations in currency rates, stock availability, and the emotional response of organic partners are accounted for.
trait_cyborg_power_intensive_desc: These cybernetic components require frequent recharging from an external power source.
trait_self_modified_desc: Members of this offshoot species have spontaneously altered their genetic makeup to give themselves an advantage.
ap_biovirus_purge_desc: The Bio-virus created by the Undine has spread across many worlds transforming them into uninhabitable nightmares. With this we may return life to these infested worlds.
ap_borg_assimilation_drive_desc: Engage advanced Assimilation procedures which increases the number of non-assimilated species assimilated by 5 per month.
ap_borg_assimilation_drive_tooltip: Apply advanced assimilation methods to increase the number of pop assimilated by an extra 5 per month.
ap_cardassian_ships_of_the_line_desc: Unlocks Hutet and Ekoor Class Ships.
ap_close_the_portals_desc: For too long our enemies have had access to our territory via their portals. We must task our top scientific minds with the job of closing these portals for good.
ap_dominion_ships_of_the_line_desc: Unlocks Shrike and Battleship Class Ships.
ap_holographical_freedom_desc: Ah, welcome. You've made an excellent choice. You're about to take part in a thrilling first person narrative... Photonic life has earnt the right to make its own destiny and forge its own path across the stars.
ap_holographical_freedom_tooltip: Unlocks the option to provide holographic life equal rights.
ap_mind_over_matter_tooltip: Unlocks the ability to research the technology Transcendence.
ap_romulan_cloak_dagger_desc: For too long our enemies have spied within our territory, watching our fleets and monitoring our progress. Today that intrusion stops, blocking our enermies sensors from viewing our systems will allow us to to cloak our worlds and strike from them like a dagger in the back.
ap_starfleet_ships_of_the_line_desc: Unlocks Pathfinder, Excalibur and Polaris Class Ships. Some of the most advanced ships in the fleet once you have researched Future-Tech Starship Design.
ap_starfleet_ships_of_the_line_tooltip: Selecting this AP unlocks the final bonus ships from the ships of the line series.
ap_starfleet_texas_class_desc: Unlocks the Texas Class Ships, Starfleet's first fully automated Starship.
ap_suliban_expansion_desc: Limitations are not something that the Suliban should be expected to deal with, we update our bodies to better ourselves and now we update our helixes to expand our horizons.
ap_the_flesh_is_average_desc: We used to be exactly like them. Flawed, weak, organic, but we evolved to include the synthetic. Now we use both to attain perfection.
ap_the_flesh_is_strong_desc: Organic mastery is all that matters and the organic will always triumph over the machine.
ap_transcendence_desc: The goal of material acquisitions and vast tracts of land is no longer part of our society. Smaller sparser units can instead create and dispose of any required item that is desired.
ap_transwarp_protocol_desc: Transwarp conduit established, routing additional power to structural integretity. Transwarp slingshot effect stabalised. Transwarp Aperture structure is now available for construction.
ap_transwarp_protocol_tooltip: Unlocks the Borg Transwarp Catapult Megastructure.
ap_typhon_option_rom_desc:
The time has come to seek closer ties with empires that share similar objectives and ambitions to counter the threat the many alien alliances pose for us.

Adds +150 to diplomatic relationship with the following empires: The Tholian Assembly, The Breen Confederacy, The Tzenkethi Coalition, The Gorn Hegenomy and The Kinshayan Holy Order. Ends rivalries between the aforementioned (AI controlled) empires and grants diplomacy intel visibility with them.

Also available for the Tholians. Not available when at war against aforementioned empires.
ap_typhon_option_tho_desc:
The time has come to seek closer ties with empires that share similar objectives and ambitions to counter the threat the many alien alliances pose for us.

Adds +150 to diplomatic relationship with the following empires: The Tholian Assembly, The Breen Confederacy, The Tzenkethi Coalition, The Gorn Hegenomy and The Kinshayan Holy Order. Ends rivalries between the aforementioned (AI controlled) empires and grants diplomacy intel visibility with them.

Also available for the Tholians. Not available when at war against aforementioned empires.
ap_wheat_from_the_chaff_desc:
The Founders expect only the very best from our leaders, if the current crop do not satisfy the mighty Dominion leadership, we will find those that can.

Eliminates two or more non-Founder scientists below level 2 and replaces them with better ones. With the quality of the replacements increasing with the more scientists eliminated at once.
leader_trait_doctor_2_desc: This leader is considered a senior medical practitioner.
leader_trait_doctor_3_desc: This leader is has reached the top of the medical profession.
leader_trait_doctor_desc: This leader is qualified to practice medicine.
leader_trait_engineer_3_desc: Known as a miracle worker by some, this highly skilled engineer can command your flagships.
leader_trait_nurse_desc: This leader is qualified to practice nursing.
tr_adaptability_borg_1_delayed: Backup processing nodes ensure that viable adaptation strategies are never erroneously discarded, significantly increasing combat efficiency.
tr_adaptability_borg_2_delayed: Predictive data analysis integrated within existing adaptive algorithms will increase the applicability of derived solutions, preventing a wider range of threats.
tr_adaptability_borg_3_delayed: Improvements to data acquisition and analysis greatly increases the rate at which we adapt to enemy weapons configurations.
tr_adaptability_borg_4_delayed: Specialised force field emitters are required for 87.6% of all countermeasures against species native to Fluidic Space.
tr_adaptability_borg_5_delayed: Defeat is irrelevant. Upon destruction of any of our units the plexus sends out collected information for analysis at the central processing node.
tr_adaptability_borg_5_desc: 25% chance to gain +100 Ruler XP when a Borg ship is destroyed. 33% chance that a Borg Cube or Tactical Cube will spawn a Borg Sphere on destruction.
tr_assimilation_1_delayed: The chaotic era where organic empires dictated the course of galactic history is over. The Collective will now take its rightful place, guiding the lesser species towards Omega.
tr_assimilation_2_delayed: With countless billions of perspectives waiting to be directed at a given quandry, there is no field of study the Collective cannot eventually master.
tr_assimilation_3_delayed: Rapid-deployment nanotube talons significantly increase the rate and volume of nanoprobes delivered to assimilation targets, greatly reducing resistance against tactical drone operations.
tr_assimilation_4_delayed: Against highly resistant species, the battle capability of tactical drones must be elevated at least one standard deviation above previous baseline. Additional combat instruments added to servo-armatures will achieve this goal.
tr_assimilation_5_delayed: All tactical drones will be adapted to use spectrum-cycling ocular implants supported by precision targeting lasers. Identification and apprehension of priority assimilation targets will increase by a significant margin.
tr_assimilation_finish_desc:
Ascension Perks Unlocked: +1
Drone Boarding Chance: +25%
tr_automation_2_delayed: Advances in fabrication processes have yielded a +5% decrease in the time it takes to construct buildings on planets within the empire, as well as +5% increase in population assembly and +75% additional alloy production from Factory Workers.
tr_automation_3_delayed: Our scientists have discovered new algorithms to find the best research to study.
tr_automation_3_desc: Unlocks advanced technology that makes research automation possible.
tr_automation_4_delayed: Multiple efficiencies are made to the operation of Starbase. Including decreasing upkeep by -5% and increasing module and building build speed by +10% as well as increases the Starbase upgrade speed by 5%.
tr_automation_5_delayed: Advances in AI have enabled our ships to increase how long they can last and their ability to recover by connecting to all parts of the ship. This way, the energy distribution increased a lot, and the ability to build emergency forcefields in case of a hull break also increased. This raised its survivability significantly.
tr_automation_5_desc: Unlocks the technology to build a new automation component on the engineering module slots on your ships.
tr_cardassian_2_1_delayed: Our armies fight to demonstrate the might of Cardassian and to annex those deemed to be best suited to serving Cardassia.
tr_cardassian_2_2_delayed: The rights of the Cardassian people take precedence over all else and our rivals see this and fear it, our confiscation protocols ensure that it is always Cardassia first.
tr_cardassian_2_3_delayed: Life under the whip of a Cardassian guard is harsh, we Cardassians have learnt long ago how to get the most from our labor force.
tr_cardassian_2_4_delayed: The natural order of things puts the Cardassian at the top, with the directive of the Obsidian Order to guide our citizen on the correct path.
tr_cardassian_2_5_delayed: The defence of Cardassian sovereign systems will always be a priority and the new orbital defence structures will protect us from any threat and the ability to build these faster will keep our Union safer.
tr_cardassian_2_5_desc: Orbital defence stations are built a 3rd faster than before.
tr_cardassian_2_adopt_desc: Adopting the first stage of this tradition increases happiness across the Cardassian Union.
tr_connectivity_borg_1_delayed: Utilising the cortical nodes of thousands of drones, it is possible for the Collective to simultaneously design and construct planetary-scale facilities in parallel, maximising process efficiency.
tr_connectivity_borg_2_delayed: Assimilated advancements in graviton manipulation technology will enable us to further expand the Unicomplex superstructure, in order to house several billion additional drones.
tr_connectivity_borg_3_delayed: Drone shortages at critical facilities will impede territorial and technological development. Drones must be relocated in an efficient manner to those locations as quickly as possible.
tr_connectivity_borg_4_delayed: Once equipped with sufficient interlink redundancies, it is possible to establish a network of supercomplexes, distributing the production and processing capabilities of the Unicomplex across multiple unimatrices.
tr_connectivity_borg_5_delayed: Extension of territorial reach beyond the range of the Unicomplex increases the risk of mass incursions by resisting species. Recommend assimilation of existing technological platforms as auxiliary Unicomplex expansions.
tr_connectivity_borg_5_desc: Enables the construction of Subcomplexes on ruined ancient megastructures, galactic forum stations, and incomplete scientific arrays.
tr_cunning_1_delayed: Abandoning logic allows for our true emotions to take hold. Those who are our friends will remain so, but those who are our enemies will feel the full might of the Romulan Star Empire.
tr_cunning_2_delayed: Having legions of informants across the empire ensures that weakness and unrest will be easily quashed, as well as providing surveillance networks for our defence forces.
tr_cunning_3_delayed: Using alien races to supplement our legions is an effective way of bolstering our military. To ensure loyalty, we offer the highest honour - with service comes citizenship.
tr_cunning_4_delayed: An imperial bureaucracy spanning the Star Empire allows for every Romulan to know their place.
tr_cunning_4_desc: Our £ Unity output is increased by +5%. Continuing Committee Senators now also increase £ Administrative Capacity by 5.
tr_cunning_5_delayed: Our greatest legacy since leaving Vulcan has been the creation of a Star Empire that spans many systems, using our superior cunning to conquer and absorb new worlds into our mighty empire.
tr_diplomacy_insider_trading_delayed: Bringing foreign peoples to our worlds to experience our culture and showcase their own is one way to improve relations between two alien cultures. By creating areas, designed to give foreigners a fresh start on our worlds, we can increase the likelihood foreigners will find our worlds hospitable.
tr_discovery_faith_in_science_desc: Survey Speed is increased by +35% and Science Ship Disengage Chance is increased by +50%.
tr_diversity_1_delayed: The individuality of each member of our society is something to be championed, not quashed. Each individual brings new strengths to the table, new ways of looking at problems, and new ways of finding solutions. By ensuring that we offer everyone a voice, we can spread our ideals far and wide.
tr_diversity_2_delayed: Delegating command authority to local captains can increase the capabilities of our far-reaching survey vessels by allowing a degree of autonomy and trust to our captains. They are the initial explorers, ambassadors, and envoys of our society, tasked with embracing the galaxy beyond our frontiers.
tr_diversity_3_delayed: Learning about diversity is not the same as experiencing it. Field trips to alien cultures and foreign worlds are an important part of the diversity process.
tr_diversity_4_delayed:
The public has finally come to regard science as more than simply a tool for the development of hi-tech toys and goods, but see it as it truly is - the ultimate way to answer the challenges this galaxy throws at us.

There is no question in this universe so big that it cannot be answered by science. Now that our leaders embrace the scientific method, it will clearly lead to better informed decisions.
tr_diversity_5_delayed: When we dare to cross the threshold that separates organic with artificial intelligence, something miraculous happens.
