tr_dominance_1_delayed: Our psychic connection allows our race of many to speak with the voice of one. One powerful voice that demands the subjection of all those who are inferior.
tr_dominance_2_delayed: With a large production of biomass, our vessels and starbases can be refitted and upgraded to our highest standards.
tr_dominance_3_delayed: Our biological prowess surpasses all our rivals, careful observation is more than enough to demonstrate our superiority.
tr_dominance_4_delayed: Our biological dominance is power enough to ensure that all inferior species tremble at our feet.
tr_dominance_5_delayed: Perfecting a race such as ours is no easy feat, but our science how allowed our species to further its goal towards biological perfection.
tr_domination_adopt_desc: Adopting the first stage of the Domination tradition tree allows us to Subjugate and Vassalize other empires and decreases the Clear Blocker Cost by -33%.
tr_domination_colonial_viceroys_desc: The Governor Level Cap is increased by 2.
tr_dominion_2_1_delayed: Our Jem'Hadar forces are unmatched in their loyalty and the ferocity in which they do battle, driving their will for battle only increases their skill on the battlefield.
tr_dominion_2_2_delayed: We claim Dominion over all around us and we enforce this with our powerful fleets who make sure that the Founders power is respected and brings fear.
tr_dominion_2_2_desc:
Country naval cap add: +50
Country command limit add: +15
tr_dominion_2_3_delayed: The will of the Founders is only increased when facing its rivals. When rivaled the Dominion War machine works at its best.
tr_dominion_2_3_desc: Rivalries now produce crew faster and influence is produced +10% faster.
tr_dominion_2_4_delayed: Not all battles are won on the battlefield, some are won via intelligence and espionage. The Founders can be anyone and see anything.
tr_dominion_2_5_delayed: Our Battleships are unmatched on the field of battle and once deployed can swiftly crush any resistance.
tr_dominion_2_5_desc:
Man-O-War Build Speed +33%
Anti-shield weapons now fire +15% faster.
tr_dominion_2_finish: Dominion over the Solids Traditions Finished
tr_dominion_2_finish_desc: Adopting all the Dominion Tier 2 tree traditions unlocks an Ascension Perk and grants us superior fire rate over minor empires.
tr_eugenics_1_delayed: The Genetics lab is home to all discoveries centred on the genome and a home to the brightest in this field.
tr_eugenics_2_delayed: The fastest route to death is to stand still and let it come to you, tailoring our bodies to meet the future will ensure our survival.
tr_eugenics_3_delayed: Genetic superiority comes from knowing that our core makeup is better than our competition and mastering our biology will drive our species forwards.
tr_eugenics_4_delayed: The technique to change the characteristics of a plant, animal or micro-organism by transferring a piece of DNA from one organism to a different organism.
tr_eugenics_5_delayed: Eugenics is a philosophy or practice of extremely selective breeding, which breed very specific traits into or out of a group of organisms taken to the next step via genetic modification.
tr_federation_1_delayed: This bureau is charged with the industrialisation of developing worlds to ensure Federation technology is brought to their worlds, and to bring them up to the same level of development as the rest of the Federation.
tr_federation_1_desc: Allows special Member World Research Programmes to be undertaken at the Federation science station.
tr_federation_2_1_delayed: The Cochrane Institute offers a home for the best and brightest in warp theory and space travel.
tr_federation_2_2_delayed: Breakthroughs in sensor imaging and holo technology have allowed for advancements in the field of Stellar Cartography, with the right focus this wiil improve our abilities to map the stars.
tr_federation_2_3_delayed: The UFP works best when its citizens collaborate and bring the best of the species together with the best of another, this sense of all being in it together results in a sense of unity across the Federation.
tr_federation_2_3_desc: Country produces +1% more unity. /nStarbase capacity increased by 5 /n Time needed to demote unemployed population is redced by 20%
tr_federation_2_4_delayed: Federation citizens feel most at ease when they know they are safe, the security bureaus help maintain the illusion of peace and safely across Federation worlds.
tr_federation_2_5_delayed: Exploring new cultures can you to civilisations old and new. Using the latest in camo technology allows us to get closer to our subjects of interest and observe them in ever closer detail.
tr_federation_2_5_desc: Unlocks more research produced from Observation Missions and access to the Watchtower Class Megastructure and Osler-Science Hull at Tier 9./nStarbase capacity increased by 5
tr_federation_2_adopt_desc: Adopting the first stage of this tradition increases the Federation's first contact processes.
tr_federation_2_delayed: The Federation Merchant Association is a service organisation charged with the duty of moving cargo and goods vital to the survival and expansion of the Federation. Distinct from the Federation Starfleet, it still works with Starfleet as a complementary organisation with definite associations and personnel answering to both services.
tr_federation_2_desc:
Unlocks access to the unique Federation policy, which enables you to set the focus of Federation member worlds across the galaxy.
Unlocks new tradition: Federation Charter
tr_federation_3_delayed: Arising from the need to understand different species' biological functions, Starfleet Medical has physicians and researchers from all over the Federation, each putting their own strengths towards improving medical health across the Federation.
tr_federation_3_desc: Efficient healthcare reduces [GetCrimeDeviancy] by -10 and improves Stability by +5.
tr_federation_4_delayed: Cultural exchange between potential Federation members and our people allows for greater understanding between parties.
tr_federation_4_desc: Adopting this tradition reduces the cost of bringing new civilisations into the Federation to 75% of its original cost.
tr_federation_5_delayed: Every species has different etiquette and procedures that require flexibility from all parties involved. Setting up adaptive protocols for member worlds to follow allows for improved political sway from their delegates.
tr_federation_5_desc: Ambassadors working at the £ Embassy Complex now also increases Country Trust Cap by 5.
tr_federation_adopt_desc: Adopting the first stage of the Federation tradition tree allows for the construction of the £ Embassy Complex to house powerful Ambassadors from Member Worlds if you are the United Federation of Planets. It also allows for the crewing of certain starships with Interspecies Crew.
tr_ferengi_2_1_delayed: Any fool can see that war is good for business, increased demand for weapons and ships to fight means the more we can provide the greater the profit.
tr_ferengi_2_2_delayed: More peace means more time to make profit and a dead business Ferengi cannot make a sale. The faster we travel in allied space the more we can achieve.
tr_ferengi_2_2_desc: Our ships travel +25% faster whilst in allied territory.
tr_ferengi_2_3_delayed: A static business is a dying business, providing incentives to ensure growth will expand our territory and our profit margins.
tr_ferengi_2_3_desc:
Starbase Shipyard Build Speed +5%
Starbase Capacity Add +6
tr_ferengi_2_4_delayed: The more you know, the more you can use to convince your customers they want, faster research drives higher profit.
tr_ferengi_2_5_delayed: It should be known that all have their price and a well placed bribe can achieve more than any hard work.
tr_ferengi_2_5_desc: Access to a unique Ferengi Bribery system to gain intel from other powers.
tr_ferengi_2_adopt_desc: Adopting the first stage of this tradition decreases the base cost of Frigates by 5% and provides 2 additional envoys.
tr_ferengi_2_finish_desc: Adopting all the Ferengi Tier 2 tree traditions unlocks an Ascension Perk.
tr_futility_borg_1_delayed: By installing local data nodes with assimilated tactical patterns, we can improve the baseline engagement efficiency of our vessels by a significant margin.
tr_futility_borg_2_delayed: All fleet coordination nodes will be upgraded with auxiliary transceivers coded for tactical subcommand pathways, increasing maximum combat response capacity.
tr_futility_borg_3_delayed: Vessels will be enhanced with newly assimilated targeting arrays, enabling rapid acquisition and neutralisation of threats on an efficient refire cycle.
tr_futility_borg_4_delayed: Orbit-to-surface plasma bombardment capability may be enhanced by sheathing the unstable energy matrix within an isothermal containment field, ensuring maximum yield is delivered regardless of atmospheric conditions.
tr_futility_borg_5_delayed: Utilising data received from temporal transceivers in Unimatrix 01, our weapons may be adapted to overwhelm the defenses of high-threat species with advanced technological distinctiveness.
tr_glory_1_delayed: Revenge is a dish best served cold. Many young, brave Klingon warriors forget this. They think of nothing else but charging the enemy. But it is the true warrior who can put aside his lust for battle to strategise, to think, to plan, and bring down a superior foe.
tr_glory_2_delayed: The loud cries of battle and the sounds of clashing weapons are in our people from a young age. Every victory, every conquest, every planet that falls beneath our feet brings glory to all the Empire.
tr_glory_3_delayed: To die in glorious battle is one of the most honourable things that a Klingon warrior can do. By instilling this tradition in our warriors, we can ensure that even when defeat seems inevitable, today is a good day to die.
tr_glory_4_delayed: A sharp knife is nothing without a sharp eye. To defeat an enemy, one must know the enemy. For those brave enough to chart the unknown, there will be glory eternal in the halls of Sto-Vo-Kor.
tr_glory_4_desc: The Science Ship Disengage Chance is increased by +50%.
tr_glory_5: Great Men Do Not Seek Power
tr_glory_5_delayed: Great men do not seek power, they have power thrust upon them. These teachings from Kahless tell us who is truly worthy of the honour and glory to lead our people.
tr_great_houses_1_delayed: Reduces the impact from the Divided Patronage debuff from -1 to -0.25.
tr_great_houses_2_delayed: A Klingon is bred to for war and to bring honour to his house, and war is a chance to bring glory to ones house.
tr_great_houses_2_desc: All loyal houses form a stronger opinion of their Empire whilst it is at war.
tr_great_houses_3_delayed: Noble Houses that have proven themselves in battle shall reap the rewards they have earned.
tr_great_houses_3_desc: The Empire gains the power to promote the Klingon Noble Houses to full Great Houses.
tr_great_houses_4_delayed: Recognition of the power of a Klingon's bloodline promotes loyalty from that House.
tr_great_houses_4_desc: Houses have their loyalty increased by +25 to the Empire!
tr_great_houses_5: Glory to you and your House
tr_great_houses_5_delayed: A Klingon warrior lives and dies by the honour that he gains through battle.
tr_great_houses_5_desc: Each victory achieved by the Empire increases the Great Houses trust and opinion of the Chancellor and every victory for the great house brings glory to its leadership.
tr_great_houses_finish_desc:
Ascension Perks Unlocked: +1
Unlocks OptionA Fresh Start which allows the Empire to spend Unity to rebuild trust and their relationship with a wayward house.
tr_harmony_bulwark_of_harmony_delayed: All organisms, no matter how perfect, must rely on an immune system to ward off the threat of outside disease. Our intergalactic society is no different. We must put our differences asides and seek allies, create a peacekeeping and humanitarian armada that will keep our people safe. Only then can we find peace, and with peace, true contentment.
tr_harmony_bulwark_of_harmony_desc: The £ Happiness of all £ Pops is increased by +5%.
tr_harvesting_borg_1_delayed: Adapting transporter pattern buffers with tetragonal manifold compression algorithms will enable long range harvesting vessels to retrieve additional surface mass from selected targets.
tr_harvesting_borg_1_desc: Increases the resource output and maximum colony size of the Colony Harvest operation by +100%.
tr_harvesting_borg_2_delayed: By dynamically organising priority subcommands based on predicted responses, our operational efficiency will be greatly increased.
tr_harvesting_borg_3_delayed: Utilising transwarp conduits to covertly intercept signal data from unassimilated species may yield new information and opportunities to further the Collective's goals.
tr_harvesting_borg_4_delayed: Expertise gathered from existing Borg drone species may be leveraged to quickly assess the cultural distinctiveness of new species targeted for assimilation.
tr_harvesting_borg_5_delayed: Additional data nodes installed throughout the Collective's vessels will ensure that our accumulated knowledge and experience is properly collated and archived.
tr_harvesting_borg_adopt_desc: Unlocks the Colony Harvest special Espionage Operation, enabling rapid deconstruction and assimilation of targeted colonies.
tr_holographic_1_delayed:
The basic notion behind the hologram is to provide entertainment for the masses, enacting scenarios and performances that regular entertains are unable to match.

Requires: Virtual Research Assistant
tr_holographic_2_delayed:
A more flamboyant version of the entertainment program designed and created to bring joy.

Requires: Holodeck
tr_holographic_2_desc: Unlocks the holographic artisan program and the ability to modify the holographic profiles.
tr_holographic_3_delayed:
The basic holographic workforce program, designed to do the jobs that you don't want to do.

Requires: Holographic Training Simulator
tr_holographic_4_delayed:
Designed to complement our military and defence services these holographic programs are not to be messed with.

Requires: Independent Integrated Holomatrix
tr_holographic_4_desc: Unlocks the holographic security program and the holographic defence army.
tr_holographic_5_delayed:
Designed to hold the collective wisdom of the best medical experts of the time to revolutionise healthcare.

Requires: Long-Term Medical Holographic Program
tr_holographic_5_desc: Unlocks the holographic Doctor and Scientist program.
tr_holographic_adopt_desc: Adopting all the Holographic traditions unlocks access to the unique holographic pop and the start of the holographic journey.
tr_honour_1_delayed: Our people thirst for the thrill of battle, the chance to earn honour for their Houses. Battle emboldens their spirits.
tr_honour_2_delayed: Collecting war trophies from honourable fallen foes can bring prestige and honour to a Klingon warrior. The greatest warriors have the greatest trophies, after all.
tr_honour_2_desc: War trophies reduce our Market Fee by -5%.
tr_honour_3_delayed: With great honour comes legacies that must be preserved. Great houses of the mightiest warriors are formed over time. They are led by the elders, each commanding large military forces and holdings.
tr_honour_3_desc:
Improves Stability by +20 on all our planets.
Unlocks a new tradition: Spirit of Kahless
tr_honour_4_delayed: Each house has war banners that our warriors can rally behind, banners that have been present in battles for many years, with the greatest honours being brought to those who wield those of the Klingon Empire itself.
tr_honour_5_delayed: Notions of honour are often very subjective, but putting emphasis on clear objectives, such as victory, make Klingon warriors able to deduce honourable conduct. There is nothing more honourable than victory!
tr_honour_5_desc: The £ Happiness of all £ Pops is increased by +5%. Councilors now also increase £ Administrative Capacity by 5.
tr_imperious_1_delayed: Since the first days that humanity seized its position of power, the Empire has made its goal to ensure humanity is never defeated.
tr_imperious_2_delayed: The famous salute that all Imperial Officers know is drilled into Terran recruits from the moment they join the academy and draws more support from loyal subjects.
tr_imperious_3_delayed: The Empresses will hold dominion over the Terran Empire and that will is enforced by the loyal Terran Army.
tr_imperious_4_delayed: Terran Leaders must continually prove themselves worthy of their command, this constraint drive to to be the best leaders to the best caliber commanders.
tr_imperious_5_delayed: The Empire must expand or die and strength is built from our powerful base of operations.
tr_imperious_adopt_desc: Adopting the first stage of the Imperious tradition tree will increase our Starbase Capacity by +3% and increase our population happines by +5%.
tr_kessok_1_delayed: One of our proudest and most common jobs across the Heliolatry.
tr_kessok_2_delayed: Years of development have paid off granting us access to the best energy collection in the galaxy.
tr_kessok_2_desc: Unlocks access to more advanced Kessok Solar Panel.
tr_kessok_3_delayed: The Kessok have always been proud warriors and now is no different.
tr_kessok_4_delayed: We will protect our systems from any threats across the galaxy.
tr_kessok_5_delayed: Our unique biology will not stop us, we will refroge the galaxy to our needs.
tr_kessok_finish_desc: Unlocks Kessok Solar Battery on stations; 25% increase to Kessok Solar Panels.
tr_klingon_2_1_delayed: The spoils of War helps fuel a warrior's drive and determination and a warrior with drive is a fearful sight on the battlefield.
tr_klingon_2_1_desc: Army damage is improved by +5% and army attack morale damage is increased by a further +5%.
tr_klingon_2_2_delayed: A warrior who knows the lay of the land can fight more effectively, only a fool runs into battle unprepared.
tr_klingon_2_3_delayed: A Klingon warrior knows the the importance of home and the pride in the Empire. Battle lust is fueled when the Klingons feel that the empire is under threat.
tr_klingon_2_3_desc: Ship home territory fire rate increases by +10%.
tr_klingon_2_4_delayed: A Klingon leader demands respects and takes what is owed to him, any powerful leader knows this and is worthy of leading an Armada in the name of Kahless himself.
tr_klingon_2_5_delayed: A victory demands respect and honour and should be celebrated with song and drink.
tr_klingon_2_5_desc: Any victorious Klingon ship is rewarded with influence and unity.
tr_klingon_2_adopt_desc: Adopting the first stage of this tradition increases the honour and joy in every warriors heart.
tr_klingon_2_finish_desc: Adopting all the Klingon Tier 2 tree traditions unlocks an Ascension Perk and embodies the Great Houses with the Spirit of Kahless.
tr_logic_1_delayed: Kolinahr describes both the Vulcan ritual by which all remaining vestigial emotions are demonstrated as purged and the mental discipline whereby this state is subsequently maintained. It is a path of pure logic.
tr_logic_1_desc: The Leader Level Cap of all leaders are increased by 1.
tr_logic_2_delayed: The Vulcan Expeditionary Group is a Vulcan organisation dedicated to logical exploration. Its members are trained at the Vulcan Learning Centre and the Vulcan Science Academy.
tr_logic_3_delayed: The Academy is the home of some of the greatest scientists on the planet and includes the works of deceased individuals who had left either written or electronic records behind. Only those on the path of logic can study here, any emotional display can ruin a prospective Vulcan's entry into the Science Academy.
tr_logic_3_desc: The Vulcan Science Academy improves our [GetSpecialist] Pop Resource Output by +5%.
tr_logic_4_delayed: It is only logical that Vulcans will experience emotions at points in their lives; meditation is required to keep emotions in check. By teaching our people meditative techniques. we can calm their emotional state and return them to a balanced state of mind, ensuring that they live long and prosper.
tr_logic_4_desc: Increases the $MOD_LEADER_AGE$ of our leaders by 20 years.
tr_logic_5_delayed: The origins of the kahs-wan originate from the ancient Vulcan warrior days. When we turned to logic, our ancestors reasoned that we needed to maintain the tests of courage and strength to keep pure logic from making us weak and helpless. The kahs-wan, or maturity test, is a traditional survival test of adulthood for adolescent Vulcans, where the objective is to survive ten days without food, water, or weapons in Vulcan's Forge.
tr_logic_5_desc: Increases Leader Experience Gain by +33% and improves army morale by +10%.
tr_might_1_delayed: The Force of our character strengthens our resolve during defensive wars making us a a formidable foe when against the ropes. Unlocking this tradition will grant the option to rename ships in honour for fallen leaders.
tr_might_2_delayed: Our strenght of will is tested most when we are attacked fuelling our citizens to build faster and stronger.
tr_might_3_delayed: When we have the courage of our convictions others flock to our side and to our cause.
tr_might_4_delayed: With justice on our side we can take so much more punishment knowing that we have right behind us.
tr_might_5_delayed: Our ideology is all that matters it fuels our way of life and it should be that way for all others who dare oppose us.
tr_might_5_desc: Pacifist & the UFP countries are able to use the Impose Ideology Casus Belli whilst the other may select a neighbouring country to target for a unique Casus Belli.
tr_obsidian_order_1_delayed: Operations within the Order are meticulously managed and controlled, order handlers keep close watch on their agents and failure is not tolerated.
tr_obsidian_order_2_delayed: The Order keeps tabs on anyone they consider a threat to Cardassia, whether they are friend or foe.
tr_obsidian_order_2_desc:
Espionage hostile operation difficulty: +1.2
Espionage hostile operation cost: -0.2
tr_obsidian_order_3_delayed: Certain agents of the Order are also equipped with cranial implants so that they can better resist torture. They also developed a substance called promazine, which its operatives use in case of capture.
tr_obsidian_order_4_delayed: Infiltration techniques are a time honoured tradition of Order agents replacing high placed targets to gain intel at the highest levels.
tr_obsidian_order_5_delayed: The order operates on fear and intimidation, which performs much of the role of keeping the population in order as the agents themselves.
tr_obsidian_order_adopt_desc: Adopting the first stage of the Obsidian Order tradition tree empowers the Cardassian secret service.
tr_order_1_delayed: It is our will that the Cardassian State shall endure for over a thousand years. Each Cardassian will do their part, as will our subject races - in the labour camps, working for the greatness of Cardassia.
tr_order_1_desc: The Leader Level Cap of all leaders are increased by 1.
tr_order_2_delayed: Ceremonial daggers, passed down through the ages, allow true Cardassian families to know their past and to honour their descendants. To be granted one of these daggers is a large boon in status to one's family, and new daggers can only awarded by bravery in the line of duty.
tr_order_3_delayed: New technologies can bring change and upheaval, disrupting order. To manage the tide of research, ensuring all technologies are safe for the Cardassian Union, a ministry of science should be instituted.
tr_order_3_desc: Increases Research Alternatives by 1 and Science Ship Disengage Chance by +50%.
tr_order_4_delayed: These institutes provide the children of the upper echelons of Cardassian society with the education to maintain their positions in the High Classes. This allows for the continuation of the belief in Cardassian society that each generation requires an elite class of leaders, in every aspect of society, to ensure order.
tr_order_5_delayed: The repetitive epic is a genre of literature characterised by a repetition of plot elements and themes. 'The Never Ending Sacrifice' is generally regarded as the genre's greatest example, and its impact upon our people shows that whilst the struggles will remain, greatness can be achieved if everyone does their part.
tr_order_5_desc: Our £ Unity output is increased by +5%.
tr_perfection_1_delayed: Cutting lag in transwarp transmission by 3.878% resulted in a research data processing speed increase of 5.226%. We will deploy the surplus computing power gained towards attempting to explain the surplus computing power gained.
tr_perfection_2_delayed: Diplomacy is irrelevant. Contact with primitive species prior to categorisation, pacification, and assimilation is irrelevant. Disregard incoming transmissions. Continue on standard course unless new technological or biological distinctiveness is detected.
tr_perfection_3_delayed: All task-leader drone functions shall be equipped with additional interlink nodes to expedite relevant knowledge-sharing processes.
tr_perfection_3_desc: Whenever a leader gains a level, other leaders each gain +100 XP. Each leader may gain up to 1000 XP this way before interlink protocols must be reset, preventing additional gain for 360 days.
tr_perfection_4_delayed: Introducing a two-layer, cross-comparing security override algorithm into each exploration drone's servo-armature interface will enable efficient nullification of hostile computer lockout protocols.
tr_perfection_5_delayed: The latest generation of explorer drones improves on previous models by automatically comparing their findings in each new environment to a centralised database of known galactic phenomena, flagging previously unexamined data for further study.
tr_politics_bureaucracy_state_delayed: Greatly expanded our civil servants has led to removing several backlogs on the administration of our citizens.
tr_politics_bureaucracy_state_desc: Unlocks the technology to build a new automation component on the engineering module slots on your ships.
tr_politics_diplomancy_first_delayed: Our ambassadors are making several in-roads with foreign empires.
tr_politics_expanded_policies_delayed: Using the political will we have gained, our empire can pass new policies to direct the future of our nation.
tr_politics_political_parties_delayed: Creating several different political parties for our citizens to join has increased their feelings of belonging to our empire.
tr_politics_political_parties_desc: Unlocks advanced technology that makes research automation possible.
tr_politics_politicking_delayed: By promising the citizens of our empire what they want, their day-to-day burdens will be lowered.
tr_preservation_1_delayed: Diversity in the environment is a strength, not a weakness, with different species adapting to fill new niches. Ensuring we have diversification in our leaders is equally as vital.
tr_preservation_1_desc: Diversification decreases the Pop Demotion Time by -25%.
tr_preservation_2_delayed: Governing new worlds requires specialised skill sets in order to make the most of the unique territories and biomes of a new planet. By focusing governance training on these areas, we can ensure our colony and sector leaders are well prepared for governing new worlds.
tr_preservation_3_delayed: Simply by studying the methods of other species who are more suitable to the environments we hope to inhabit, we have learned new ways of adapting to alien environments.
tr_preservation_4_delayed: By allowing the strongest crops to thrive or the most suitable domesticated creatures to breed, we can ensure our worlds are as habitable as possible.
tr_preservation_5_delayed: The highest function of ecology is the understanding of consequences.
tr_preservation_5_desc: The terraforming cost is reduced by -20% for all planet-forming projects.
tr_preservation_adopt_desc: Adopting the first stage of the Preservation tradition tree decreases [GetCrimeDeviancy] by -10.
tr_productivity_1_delayed: A small quantity of artificial protomatter may be utilized to increase replication volume of high-value materials.
tr_productivity_2_delayed: We can augment replication facilities with high-yield synthesizers that will extract quantum duplicated materials from parallel micro-universes, significantly increasing output.
tr_productivity_2_desc: Unlocks £ Fabrication Complex III and allows for the recolonisation of Assimilated Planets
tr_productivity_3_delayed: Nanoprobe propagation efficiency may be vastly increased by adopting a tetrafractal replication process, enabling support of a far higher population of drones.
tr_productivity_4_delayed: Ensuring subroutes are available to manage inventory supply chains across the Collective is vital. By connecting all the parts of the supply chain via logistical subroutines, the Collective ensures that building materials are automatically replenished as construction is underway, leaving no drone underutilised.
tr_productivity_5_delayed: The energy grids that power our unicomplexes can also be used to boost the neural signals transmitted to our assembly nanites, allowing for further modifications and enhancements to our facilities with minimal resource expenditure.
tr_prophecy_1_delayed: Though many of our people ask why the Prophets do not respond to their prayers, the Prophets do communicate with the most devout of us through their prophecies, granting their wisdom.
tr_prophecy_1_desc: The Leader Level Cap of all leaders are increased by 1.
tr_prophecy_2_delayed: The home of the Prophets, the Celestial Temple, is one that has eluded us for years. Perhaps now is the time to comb the stars to find this most holy of places.
tr_prophecy_3_delayed: Our great Kais tell us that wisdom comes with age; thus, respecting and listening to our elders is important. Our elders in return can teach us about our place in this vast universe.
tr_prophecy_3_desc: The $MOD_SCIENTIST_SKILL_LEVELS$ of all scientists are increased by 1.
tr_prophecy_4_delayed: We seek guidance of the Prophets constantly. The rare few of us receive guidance from the Celestial Temple itself through experiences with their gifts, the Orbs.
tr_prophecy_4_desc: Celestial guidance increases Survey Speed by +15% and Anomaly Discovery Chance by +5%.
tr_prophecy_5_delayed: The Emissary of the Prophets is a pivotal figure in our religion. According to the prophecies, the Emissary can speak to the Prophets and will save Bajor by finding the Celestial Temple.
tr_prosperity_adopt_desc: Adopting the first stage of the Prosperity tradition tree reduces the Ship Build Cost by -10%.
tr_prosperity_pursuit_of_profit_desc: The pursuit of profit reduces our Market Fee by -5%.
tr_resilience_1_delayed: Adapting drone exo-plating with polymerised tritanium micro-layers will significantly increase survivability in hostile environments.
tr_resilience_2_delayed: Ongoing monitoring of low-priority entities operating in close proximity to our facilities will greatly increase the probability of defeating sudden hostile incursions.
tr_resilience_3_delayed: All orbital and terrestrial facilities will be adapted with triaxilating adaptive force fields to better withstand hostile incursions by unassimilated species.
tr_resilience_4_delayed: Analysis of assimilated data indicates that our modular station designs may be further upgraded with metamorphic adaptive superstructures, enabling efficient integration of new technologies.
tr_resilience_5_delayed: Rapid cycling of external bulkheads in response to damage will increase the longevity of our orbital stations in combat scenarios.
tr_revelation_undine_1_delayed: Hardwork and dedication can only take you so far, sometimes your biology gives the edge needed to succeed.
tr_revelation_undine_2_delayed: To be Undine, is to be superior, we push the boundaries of what it means to be biological.
tr_revelation_undine_3_delayed: To be Undine you must do completely different things from what has been done before or from what is usually done.
tr_revelation_undine_4_delayed: To be Undine, is to be superior in mind, body and spirit. This must be demonstrated in all aspects of life.
tr_revelation_undine_5_delayed: Our leaders must be the best of the best, selectively perfecting our leaders ensures that we get only the best of our species.
tr_romulan_2_1_delayed: The Imperial Science Initiave is a drive across all major elements within the Star Empire to combine the best minds to work on improvements that the Empire can make.
tr_romulan_2_1_desc: Increased research bonus across all technology tiers.
tr_romulan_2_2_delayed: The Quantum Singularity Drive has powered our warbirds since its discovery our studies into the power of the black hole to push our evasion speeds every faster.
tr_romulan_2_3_delayed: Our mastery of the shadows allows us to know more about our foes then ever before.
tr_romulan_2_4_delayed: The Tal Shiar know and see all and these eyes and ears watch out across the void of space giving the empire a view further than before.
tr_romulan_2_5_delayed: Victory lies in our ability to strike hard and fast from the darkness, defeating our enermies before they know they are under attack.
tr_romulan_2_5_desc: Leaders who are part of the Tal Shair or Zhat Vash have access to prototype cloaking technology that allows them to deal more damage whilst cloaked.
tr_romulan_2_adopt_desc: Adopting the first stage of this tradition increases happines across the Star Empire.
tr_romulan_2_finish_desc: Adopting all the Romulan Tier 2 tree traditions unlocks an Ascension Perk.
tr_section_31_adopt_desc: Adopting the first stage of the section 31 tradition tree enables access to the advanced espionage options.
tr_section_31_hq_delayed: Under the guise of a top secret branch office of the Federation Security services, Section 31 create hidden bureaus in order to coordinate their agents across the UFP.
tr_section_31_infiltration_agents_delaye: Section 31 agents are recruited from the very top branches of Starfleet and following years of training can appear to be the most nondescript of individuals, meaning that you may not be aware you have met one until too late.
tr_section_31_infiltration_agents_desc:
Maximum Infiltration Level +5
Unlocks Nimrod-Class escort during the Discovery Era.
tr_section_31_nda_delayed: Secrecy within Section 31 is maintained to the highest degree, agents are expected to take their lives over disclosing anything that harms the division.
tr_section_31_operational_security_delay: Operations within Section 31 are broken up into distinct cells, with no cell linking to another. Often agents will have no awareness of other activities within the Section and leaks are handled promptly.
tr_section_31_shadow_recruits_delayed: Section 31 operatives work within the shadows to do the jobs that they deem keeps the Federation space, their is no line they will not cross to ensure success. Unlocks the Deimos-Class Escort
tr_strength_1_delayed: The code of a Warrior is everything to our people - nothing else holds as much importance. Material wealth and comfort are minor things compared to the thrill of battle.
tr_strength_2_delayed: The strong lead whilst the weak perish. Our society is founded on strength, and each member strives to be better than the weaklings that have come before. In the event of an invasion, we can be sure that our population will rise in defiance to prove themselves!
tr_strength_3_delayed: Our power over those weaker than us proves our superiority. Each race that bows down to our might proves that we are the true leaders of this galaxy.
tr_strength_4_delayed: Early on we learned that hunting as a group was more effective than hunting alone - each warrior bringing unique talents to the hunting grounds. This ancient talent serves us well as we expand to the stars, as each ship can support the vessel nearest to it. True strength in numbers.
tr_strength_5_delayed: We will never bow to those who are inferior. Let them hurl themselves against our unbreakable defenses! A thousand years from now, they will just be another footnote in the history of our ascension.
tr_supremacy_finish_undine_desc:
Shield/Armor Penetration 5%
Immune to Jump Drive Events
tr_supremacy_great_game_desc: Our ships are capable of dealing increased damage to a wide range of space critters, including crystals, amoeba and ancient drones. In addition, £ Unity output increased by +10% per Rival.
tr_supremacy_undine_1_delayed: The ability to quickly reach a target increases the speed in which it can be destroyed.
tr_supremacy_undine_2_delayed: Our leaders genetics ensure they are more advanced then any rival species.
tr_supremacy_undine_3_delayed: The Undine reign supreme over the fluidic realm.
tr_supremacy_undine_4_delayed: The supply chain of any system can be optimised when all parts work together, in unity, for the good of the Vanguard. Where every spawn works towards the same goal in synchronicity, taking us every closer to removing the weak.
tr_supremacy_undine_4_desc: Regular Empires take +15% more damage than before. War exhaustion gain is reduced by -10%
tr_synchronicity_borg_1_delayed: In response to hostile incursions by unassimilated species, we have refitted all auxiliary units with tactical servo-armature enhancements, reducing the number of processing cycles needed for full combat readiness.
tr_synchronicity_borg_2_delayed: The organisation of our vessels into efficient geometric configurations allows for comprehensive application of automated construction techniques.
tr_synchronicity_borg_3_delayed: Seeding a large volume of nanoprobes across a planetary surface will enable us to quickly reconfigure the environment to serve our needs.
tr_synchronicity_borg_4_delayed: By running simultaneous course calculations via parallel navigation interlinks, our vessels can increase interstellar travel efficiency by a significant margin.
tr_synchronicity_borg_5_delayed: Coordination nodes may be improved using newly assimilated heuristic algorithms to better delegate priority tasks throughout the interlink network.
tr_tal_shiar_infiltration_delayed: Infiltration techniques are a time honoured tradition of Tal Shiar agents replacing high placed targets to gain intel at the highest levels.
tr_tal_shiar_operational_security_delaye: Internal security within the Tal Shiar is just as important, there is a reason you do not find agents who have left the organisation.
tr_tal_shiar_operations_delayed: Operations within the Tal Shiar are broken up into distinct cells, with no cell linking to another. Often agents will have no awareness of other activities within the organisation and leaks are handled promptly.
tr_tal_shiar_ruthlessness_delayed: A Tal Shiar agent must be ruthless and prepared to do whatever it takes to complete their mission.
tr_tal_shiar_shadow_agents_delayed: The Tal Shiar operate within every facet of society generating fear and order within the Romulan people.
tr_tanagra_1_delayed: This tale explains to our people that a seemingly insurmountable problem is simply a problem that needs to be overcome.
tr_tanagra_1_desc: The Leader Level Cap of all leaders are increased by 1.
tr_tanagra_2_delayed: Rai and Jiri at Lungha. Rai of Lowani. Lowani under two moons. Jiri of Ubaya. Ubaya of crossroads, at Lungha. Lungha, her sky gray. This ancient story tells us of many cultures coming together to work as one for the greater benefit of all.
tr_tanagra_2_desc: The $MOD_SCIENTIST_SKILL_LEVELS$ of all scientists are increased by 1.
tr_tanagra_3_delayed: Sokath, their eyes uncovered. This story expresses the understanding and realisation that grows inside someone as the years go by. With age comes wisdom.
tr_tanagra_3_desc: Increases the $MOD_LEADER_AGE$ of our leaders by 20 years.
tr_tanagra_4_delayed: This narrative is one that tells of going out and bringing gifts to others, and the advantages that it can bring.
tr_tanagra_4_desc: Increases Survey Speed by +15% and Anomaly Discovery Chance by +5%.
tr_tanagra_5_delayed: An epic tale of how Darmok and Jalad defeated the beast at Tanagra, which instills in all our people the drive to be as Darmok and Jalad once were.
tr_terran_1_delayed: The desire to expand the empire has gripped our subjects. Their enthusiasm and patriotic fervor grows for every new world claimed by our colonists.
tr_terran_1_desc: Enthusiasm increases our £ Trained Officers Production by +5%.
tr_terran_2_delayed: The Imperial Intelligence sees all and knows all.
tr_terran_3_delayed: Terrans know the price of suffering and the sacrifce required to succeed.
tr_terran_4_delayed: We choose our own pain. Mine helps me remember.
tr_terran_5_delayed: The Terrans dominate all in their path, resistance is met with swift justice.
tr_the_link_1_delayed: The solids desire control and order which only we can bring to them, with their obedience we gain strength.
tr_the_link_2_delayed: Our loyal Vorta enforce our will amongst the lesser races and those who do not fall in line are shown the error of their ways by our Jem'Hadar troops.
tr_the_link_2_desc: Our loyal Vorta and Jem'Hadar are produced +25% faster. Robotics upkeep cost +25% more.
tr_the_link_3_delayed: We shall suffer no less than full dedication and hard work from all who serve the Dominion The Solids owe us that much.
tr_the_link_3_desc: Jem'Hadar and Vorta job outputs are doubled whilst our slaves produce +10% more.
tr_the_link_4_delayed: The Link requires nothing but its own species and the pithy words of the solids mean nothing to us, but a Dominion cannot run on nothing.
tr_the_link_4_desc: Unlocks the Dominion tribute mechanic, every few years a member world is presented with an opertunity to pay tribute to the might of the Founders.
tr_the_link_5_delayed: The solids say knowledge is power and the Dominion does not lack in knowledge and the ability to use that to improve on all we rule over.
tr_the_link_adopt_desc: Adds a unique modifier to the Dominion that boosts resource income, trade & naval capacity that increases with the more members within the Dominion.
tr_the_link_finish_desc: Unlocks an Ascension Perk and unlocks a unique bonus for the Dominion for each new world that joins.
tr_time_1: Time, the devourer of all things
tr_time_1_delayed: The temporal shippyards house specialised equipment that allows the construction of a temporal core.
tr_time_1_desc: Unlocks The temporal shipyards capable of building the great timeship once the technology has been completed.
tr_time_2_delayed: Temporal weaponary exists in a permanent state of temporal flux, making it very difficult to stop with standard defences.
tr_time_2_desc: Increases weapon damage against shields and armour by +10%. Unlocks temporal reactor component for the Time Ship.
tr_time_3_delayed: The ability to move outside of normal space time makes our timeship a predator surgically striking at its prey.
tr_time_3_desc: Unlocks The Time jump drive allowing the Time ship to move great distances in outside of the normal fabric of time and space.
tr_time_4: The fire in which we burn
tr_time_4_delayed: They say time is the fire in which we burn. Right now, Captain, my time is running out. We leave so many things unfinished in our lives.
tr_time_4_desc: Unlocks the technology which allows the use of the Chroniton Bombardment stance and the Chroniton Planet Killer Weapon (must have armageddon DLC).
tr_time_5_delayed: Time is patient, so we must be patient with it.
tr_time_5_desc: Unlocks Chroniton shield adaption technology for use on Battleships.
tr_time_finish_desc: Adopting all the Time Tier traditions unlocks an Ascension Perk and allows the construction of the Annorax-Class Time Ship.
tr_ufp_ships_1_delayed:
The early years of Starfleet demonstrates a time when they were seeking their place in the cosmos and settling on the style that becomes synonymous with Star Trek. 
Unlocks during the Enterprise-Kelvin game eras.
tr_ufp_ships_1_desc: Unlocks the Discovery (ENT) Frigate, Endeavour Refit and NX-Beta Attack Wing.
tr_ufp_ships_2_delayed:
Starfleet began the process of discovering its own path with a variation of designs, this tradition unlocks some more traditional designs to compliment the ships of this era. 
Unlocks during the Discovery game eras.
tr_ufp_ships_2_desc: Unlocks the Farragut Class, Edison, Shran and Ranger refits.
tr_ufp_ships_3_delayed:
To many the original and best, designs that suit this period of Starfleet's history and enjoys the nostalgia of this era. 
Unlocks during the TOS game eras.
tr_ufp_ships_3_desc: Unlocks the Proxima and Loknar Classes.
tr_ufp_ships_4_delayed:
The big screen action showed the world a refitted design aesthetic fit for the grandest occasions. 
Unlocks during the periods between ST:TMP - ST:VI.
tr_ufp_ships_4_desc: Unlocks the Proxima, Loknar and Pegasus refits, the Spokane-Class variant, Shangri-La-Class and the Akyazi-Class.
tr_ufp_ships_5_delayed:
Ships fit for a New Generation of followers and the modern fan, from the next generation to voyaging across the Delta Quadrant and beyond. 
Unlocks from the TNG era onwards.
tr_ufp_ships_5_desc: Unlocks the Phoenix-Class Science and Typhon-Class Carrier, the Century-Class and Gagarin-Class Explorers, the Vigiliant-Class refit and the Achilles-Class Artillery Cruiser.
tr_ufp_ships_adopt_desc: Adopting all the Starfleet Ships of the Line traditions unlocks access to a variety of extra ships, some have unique abilities, whilst others are simply there to add more flavour to your playthrough. These designs are then available to research from Jupiter Station.
tr_ufp_ships_finish: Ships of the Line Traditions Finished
tr_ufp_ships_finish_desc: Adopting all the Ships of the Line traditions unlocks the Starfleet unique Ascension Perk UFP Ships of the Line and unlocks the Dauntless NX-01A Class.
tr_versatility_borg_1_delayed: Integrating additional R-7 low-priority nano-subprocessors into every drone will free up processing power for more important tasks.
tr_versatility_borg_2_delayed: Newly assimilated miniaturisation technology will reduce the spatial volume required for drone alcoves by a significant margin, increasing drone capacity within all major facilities.
tr_versatility_borg_3_delayed: Biological adjustments to newly assimilated drones must be optimised for ideal operational conditions.
tr_versatility_borg_4_delayed: The performance ceiling of individual autonomous drones can theoretically be raised through a complex series of optimisations and overclocking procedures.
tr_versatility_borg_5_delayed: Analysis of vinculum data transmissions between unimatrix sectors indicates an unstable variance rate of 5.015% due to spontaneous expression of irrelevant identities. Additional suppression programs will correct this error.
tr_versatility_borg_finish_desc:
Ascension Perks Unlocked: +1
Unlocks £ Automated Drone Transfer decision for £ Unicomplexes and £ Subcomplexes.
tr_versatility_operational_proxies_desc: Reduces Deviancy by -10 on all our planets.
tr_victory_1_delayed: Solids cannot understand what it means to be truly alive, locked into one shape their entire short-lived lives. They are emotional and violent creatures who must be controlled.
tr_victory_1_desc: Allows you to create an Asteroid Prison. These unique megastructures act as a fortified prison and outpost, allowing you to utilise solid £ pops for your own means. The Pop Demotion Time is reduced by -50%.
tr_victory_2_delayed: By portraying ourselves as their Gods, the loyalty of the Jem'Hadar cannot be called into question. Nevertheless, the Ketracel White ensures that their sole purpose is to serve us.
tr_victory_2_desc: Jem'Hadar may now have further genetic enhancements. Additionally, we may now proclaim the Grand Fleet and Arms Race edicts.
tr_victory_3_delayed: Our Will cannot be challenged - we are Gods amongst our Dominion. When a Founder orders their will to be carried out, the servants of the Dominion will do anything to achieve it.
tr_victory_3_desc: Subject power penalty is reduced by -33%. In addition, Changeling Infiltration is enhanced - we can now replace foreign governors and scientists. Founders now also increase £ Administrative Capacity by 5 when part of the Great Link.
tr_victory_4_delayed: The Dominion has existed for thousands of years and will exist for thousands more. Our great wisdom and leadership ensure that the Dominion will endure forever.
tr_victory_4_desc: Changeling Infiltration is perfected - we can now replace even the Rulers of foreign empires, and our infiltrators are harder to detect. This tradition also allows you to make more effective demands of your Dominion Members, requesting fleets and even planets.
tr_victory_5_delayed: The loyal Vorta were raised from primitive creatures and have served us well for many years. Further tinkering with their genome could produce more effective results.
tr_victory_5_desc: Vorta may now have further genetic enhancements. In addition the Diplomatic Influence Cost for issuing edicts is reduced by -25%.
tr_victory_finish_desc: Unlocks access to the War Doctrine policies.
tr_voth_1_delayed: The first tenet of our doctrine ensures that our advanced level of technological development is key to the success of the Voth.
tr_voth_2_delayed: The second tenet of our doctrine dictates that Voth culture surpasses all others.
tr_voth_3_delayed: The third tenet of our doctrine states that a strong Voth offense is the best defence.
tr_voth_4_delayed: The fourth tenet of our doctrine states that speed of movement and not just mind is key.
tr_voth_4_desc: Improves ship speed and interstellar speeds.
tr_voth_5_delayed: The keepers of the Doctrine, the Ministry of Elders, are both the guardians and keepers of our sacred Doctrine and to be followed above all else.
tr_voth_5_desc: The Ministry of Elders ensure a stable and happy Voth society.
tr_weak_shall_perish_delayed: The Undine have existed for thousands of years and will exist for thousands more and the weak shall tremble before us.
tr_xindi_1_delayed: The Insectoids ability to act as one has long been the envy of the other Xindi and they were quick to develop a system based on this abilty to control the weapon.
tr_xindi_1_desc: Unlocks a unique interface based on the hive mind of the Insectoids that allows a limited crew to pilot such a large vessel.
tr_xindi_2_delayed: The Primates, led by one of their leading scientists have aways been masters of destruction and this weapon they have created could be their greatest yet.
tr_xindi_2_desc: Unlocks the technology which allows the use of the Kemocite Bombardment stance and the Kemocite Planet Killer Weapon (must have armageddon DLC).
tr_xindi_3_delayed: The Arboreals produce the finest variaty of Kemocite in the Delphic Expanse and this Kemocite fuels the Weapon and the craft that houses it.
tr_xindi_3_desc: Unlocks a power core designed by the Arboreals fueled by the finest Kemocite.
tr_xindi_4_delayed: The reptiles have always produced the most dedicated and resilliant crew and it was no surprise that they would be the first to volunteer to crew the Planet Killer.
tr_xindi_4_desc: Unlocks a specially trained squad of Xindi special forces led by the Reptilians.
tr_xindi_5_delayed: The Aquatics have mastered the ability to traverse great distances as they once migrated the oceans of Xindus.
tr_xindi_5_desc: Unlocks The Aquatics ability to open spatial portals to send the weapon great distances.
tr_xindi_finish_desc: Adopting all the Xindi Tier traditions unlocks an Ascension Perk, strengthens the Council's research and fleet coordination, and allows the construction of the Xindi Superweapon.
trait_amphibian_desc: Amphibians are vertebrates which are able, when adult, to live both in water and on land.
trait_android_desc: This is a constructed Android equipped with a self aware artificial intelligence.
trait_antiquated_desc: These people are ancient, with a history that stretches back millennia. As a result, they tend to be stuck in their ways, stolid and unimaginative, incapable of quickly adapting to new world views and new philosophies and traditions.
trait_assimilated_desc: No one knows the origin of Borg, but all know the price for being their target.
trait_avian_desc: This species has a lighter bone structure and the ability to fly.
trait_bio_electrical_desc: This species has the natural ability to generate electrical discharges with their bodies .
trait_biosynthetic_desc: This is a biosynthetic android, indistinguishable from carbon based life.
trait_borg_admiral_1_desc: Drones have demonstrated a higher then average success ratio for the collective and are identified as worth having additional subroutines added.
trait_borg_admiral_2_desc: Drones have demonstrated a higher then average success ratio for the collective and are identified as worth having additional subroutines added.
trait_borg_admiral_3_desc: Drones have demonstrated a higher then average success ratio for the collective and are identified as worth having additional subroutines added.
trait_brakul_desc: All vital bodily functions are protected by a redundant organ or system. Klingons possess two livers, an eight-chambered heart, twenty-three ribs, two stomachs, three lungs, and a double-lined neural pia mater. This allows Klingons to survive injuries that normally kills other humanoids.
trait_breather_apparatus_desc: This species is unable to breathe a standard oxygen-nitrogen atmosphere and requires an apparatus to breathe in those environments.
trait_career_leader_desc: This leader had dedicated the rest of their career to serving in our navy Inspiring all those around them.
trait_catatonia_desc: This species does not handle the rigours of space travel well, and can enter a catatonic state in order to survive the ordeal. Whilst dangerous, it does reduce the overall support required.
trait_chemical_dependancy_desc: This species has become dependent on a chemical substance for their very survival.
trait_chosen_people_desc: For millennia, these people have been sheltered and guided by god-like entities, that have irrevocably shaped the course of their history and culture.
trait_chromodynamic_power_module_desc: The Progenitors of both the Pralor and Cravic automated personnel units have elected to use a chromodynamic power module in their heart of their creation. Based on a notoriously impossible to replicate matrix, the organic founders sought to limit the autonomy of their creation. Till this day, it severely restricts both species of APU's.
trait_clone_desc: This species is genetically engineered, created via advanced cloning techniques.
trait_complex_family_structures_desc: With twelve billion inhabitants on a single continent the Denobulan familial affairs are often complicated. Families are polyamorous, where a man typically has three wives, who each has three husbands.
trait_consummate_warriors_desc: The instincts of this species have been honed for millennia by internal strife and hostile fauna to produce a perfect warrior.
trait_coward_desc: There are many species that are physically small and weak and make for poor soldiers, but members of this species are also acutely aware of the fact they are not apex hunters. Even now, with modern civilisation to support them, they are hard pressed to find the courage to remain in battle.
trait_crystal_desc: The Tholians are a result of a freak evolutionary path, based on highly-energetic organic sulfur crystals. Their entire Physiology is based on crystalline-analogues, with facsimiles for DNA, metabolic processes and fluids evolving over billions of years. While this allows Tholians to live in environments every other species in the galaxy would find deadly, they themselves require a carefully balanced environment and find it difficult to survive otherwise.
trait_cunning_desc: This species is well known throughout the galaxy for its shrewdness and cunningness. Their cleverness gives them an edge in research and science, yet no one but their closest allies can truly trust them.
trait_darsay_personality_desc: The D'Arsay civilisation was destroyed millions of years ago but now lives again thanks to the storage of untold personalities within a vast data archive. Overwriting the existing personalities of their cybernetic hosts, these long dead individuals have new life.
trait_doopler_desc: This species has the unusual habit of duplicating if they become stressed, which they happen to get frequently...
trait_drednok_desc: This deadly robot enforcer is cold and heartless. His sole purpose is to follow the Orders orders and stop at nothing to execute them. Drednok is friend to no one.
trait_drug_dependancy_desc: This entire species is addicted to a narcotic substance, which after prolonged usage as made them dependant on the substance.
trait_environment_suit_dependency_desc: Since birth, every member of the Breen species is fitted with an environmental suit that will last a lifetime. Self-adjusting and adaptable, this suit keeps the Breen's temperature at a lower level than its surroundings in order to maintain the cold temperatures of their home planet.
trait_essentialist_desc: Klingon culture is not as focused on luxuries and comforts in life. Padded beds, large living quarters, and trinkets with no meaning have little place in the Klingon home.
trait_extreme_pacifist_desc: This being cannot stand violence and will avoid the violent option and all costs.
trait_feline_desc: Relating to or affecting cats or other members of the cat family.
trait_fleet_admiral_desc: This leader is one of our most senior Admiral within our fleet following a dedicated career in service to our fleet.
trait_fleet_captain_desc: This leader has reached the rank of Fleet Captain, and given the command of a fleet of starships.
trait_fleet_commodore_desc: This leader has reached the first flag officer rank capable of commanding a small fleet, task force or facility.
trait_fluidic_species_desc: This species have developed in the harshness of Fluidic Space and their biology has mastered the challenges of this hostile environment.
trait_four_hearts_desc: Four hearts ensure this species is hardy in many strenuous circumstances and situations.
trait_fragmented_desc: This empire is myriad mix of conflicting and vastly different ideologies, political factions and religious movements. It is a wonder they can get anything done in this state.
trait_gorn_infant_desc: This species' young are wild and feral, fighting for dominance and a chance to survive.
trait_heightened_senses_desc:
Unlike most humanoid species across the galaxy, the Kelpien have evolved from a fully herbivore ancestor. Living in large herds for mutual protection in the highly competitive eco-system of Kel, evolutionary pressure forced the Kelpien to develop highly sophisticated senses. They now possess an instinctive awareness of any possible danger to themselves or their herd.

'My people were biologically determined for one purpose alone: to sense the coming of death' - Lt. Saru
trait_highly_industrious_desc: A hive like mind and a work ethic where only the results of the hive matter results in an extremely industrious insectoid.
trait_highly_talented_desc: Members of this species are born with an incredibly agile and flexible mind, giving them a natural aptitude in every area they choose to excel in.
trait_holographic_artisan_desc: This Hologram has basic protocols, designed for commercial tasks.
trait_holographic_desc: This being is a generated, three-dimensional, photonically-based projection of light, energy, and force fields.
trait_holographic_ech_desc: This Hologram is programmed with this cultures command and control knowledge base.
trait_holographic_emh_desc: This Hologram is programmed with this cultures medical knowledge base.
trait_holographic_entertainment_desc: This Hologram is programmed with a full set of entertainment programs.
trait_holographic_science_desc: This Hologram is programmed with this cultures scientific knowledge base.
trait_holographic_worker_desc: This Hologram has basic protocols, designed for manual work.
trait_iconian_1_desc: This entire species has evolved over eons to be more than just biological.
trait_iconian_2_desc: This species has mastered their biological form using technology that we cannot begin to comprehend.
trait_jem_cognitive_reasoning_desc: Modifies the blockers in the Jem'Hadar cognitive structure designed for obedience to give them more freedoms allowing for improved mental reasoning and independence.
trait_jem_high_endurance_desc: Enhancement to the genetic structure allow for built in resilience to shock and blunt force trauma.
trait_jem_low_light_desc: Low light vision is the extraordinary ability to see with almost no light source at all, a great boon to have during night battles and other low light situations.
trait_jem_spartan_life_desc: Enhancements to genome of these Jem'Hadar allows them to take even more required nutrients and resources from the Ketracel White, leaving them almost entirely self-reliant. Except for the White.
trait_jem_super_metabolism_desc: A streamlined genetic sequence results in a much simpler cloning method, reducing complexity and resources required.
trait_jem_terror_battle_desc: Adrenal enhancements that give short bursts of massively enhanced strength and speed to strike fear into the hearts of their opponents.
trait_joined_trill_desc: The union between Trill host and Symbiont to create a new individual merging the mind a bodies of both native species of the planet Trill. A great honour amongst both species.
trait_kelpien_delicious_desc: The Kelpiens have been domesticated, grown and farmed systematically over the millennia. Their flesh is a highly prized delicacy.
trait_kelpien_prevaharai_desc: The Kelpiens have always been told that the Vahar'ai brings death, living a life of constant fear has become the normal for them.
trait_kelpien_vaharai_desc: Kelpiens transformed by the Vahar'ai have been given a new lease of life.
trait_ketracel_white_addiction_desc: This species has been genetically engineered to require a regular intake of the drug £ Ketracel White, providing enhanced strength at the cost of obedience to the supplier of the drug.
trait_listener_desc: This species are renown for their talents at listening and taking onboard information.
trait_logical_desc: This species lives by a strict code of logic, which overwrites all emotional responses, to the point in which emotion is often purged from the individual, In other words the needs of the many outweigh the needs of the few.
trait_low_gravity_desc: This species evolved on a low gravity world, and required specialised equipment to travel outside of that environment.
trait_master_geneticist_desc:
None can hope to compete with their mastery of genetic engineering. In time they can reach levels of expertise to which the galaxy has never seen.

Unlocks a new path of advanced genetic engineering technologies.
trait_mechanical2_desc: Mechanical beings are several orders of magnitude more complex than the purpose-built automatons of old, but most possess fairly limited processing capabilities.
trait_metaphasic_radiation_desc: This species has undergone treatment formulated from the Metaphasic Radiation found on Ba'ku.
trait_narrowminded_desc: Klingon society is generally focused on war and being strong and the heart of a warrior. This has led to a society that cared little for heath and cultural science and focused heavily on technology that would make for better, stronger warriors.
trait_natural_pheromones_desc: This species has developed natural Pheromones which give it an advantage, often when persuading other species to certain points of view.
trait_necrogenesis_desc:
The majority of this species are unable to reproduce sexually and instead require the conversion of the deceased via the application of an irreversible genetic virus.

Beings converted in such a fashion rarely retain their original personalities, but often remember skills learned from their previous lives.
trait_non_corporeal_desc: This species has shed its corporeal body and now exists in a state of pure energy consciousness.
trait_partially_assimilated_desc: The process of Assimilation has begun, this species has taken their first step towards perfection...
trait_pc_assimilated_cold_preference_des: We will bend nature to our will.
trait_pc_assimilated_hot_preference_desc: We will bend nature to our will.
trait_pc_assimilated_preference_desc: We will bend nature to our will.
trait_pc_barren_cold_sub_preference_desc: Class C (Geoinactive) environments are not often found to harbour life.
trait_pc_bioworld_preference_desc: This species has been genetically engineered to thrive on bioworlds within Fluidic Space.
trait_pc_gemworld_preference_desc: Climate preference is determined at the genetic level, by eons of evolution or skillful manipulation.
trait_pc_helix_preference_desc: This species lives on the modular and ever changing confines of a Suliban Helix.
trait_pc_hunters_lodge_preference_desc: An ideal training space from where to prepare the Hunt.
trait_pc_infested_preference_desc: Fluidic Space has honed this species development in a number of unique ways.
trait_pc_k_ares_class_preference_desc: Climate preference is determined at the genetic level, by eons of evolution or skillful manipulation.
trait_pc_k_luna_class_preference_desc: Only the hardiest and most robust of settlers would choose to make a living on this frontier.
trait_pc_proto_bio_preference_desc: This species has been genetically engineered to thrive on proto-bioworlds within Fluidic Space.
trait_pc_subcomplex_preference_desc: Climate preference is determined at the genetic level, by eons of evolution or skillful manipulation.
trait_pc_thegreatlink_preference_desc: A merging of form and thought, the sharing of idea and sensation.
trait_pc_unimatrix_preference_desc: An atmosphere with a constant temperature of 39.1 Celsius, 92% relative humidity, and atmospheric pressure of approximately 102 kPa.
trait_pc_voth_city_ship_preference_desc: This ancient race lives mostly on huge city ships.
trait_pc_y_class_preference_desc: Climate preference is determined at the genetic level, by eons of evolution or skillful manipulation.
trait_psionic_masters_desc: With sufficient research, we have unlocked the full potential of our telepathic abilities. Many members of society now possess advanced psionic powers, capable of manipulating objects at a distance, sensing movements in subspace and even having limited insights into the future.
trait_quickening_desc: A disease introduced into the Teplan population by the Jem'Hadar in response to the population's resistance to the Dominion.
trait_rear_admiral_desc: This leader is a senior Admiral within our fleet following a dedicated career in service to our fleet.
trait_rebels_desc: This species are naturally inclined to rebel against anything and everyone.
trait_reclusive_desc: Evolution has made the Kelpien cautious to a fault, wary of the outdoors and new territories. Very few of their members ever dare to leave their home grounds, not to mention their home planet. It is safe to say that colonization is a troublesome prospect for this species, and not one taken lightly.
trait_reptilian_desc: Reptilians are cold blooded creatures, with some regenerative properties.
trait_resilient_vaadwaar_desc: Only the luckiest of the best and brightest survived the orbital devastation unleashed upon the Vaadwaur centuries ago. Now released from stasis, the future is theirs to seize.
trait_revered_elders_desc: Genetic modifications to the rapid aging gene will allow many more years of useful life.
trait_rigid_desc: This species has a complex, intricate culture, draped with mannerism and catechism. Change comes to them slowly, if it comes at all.
trait_rock_skin_desc: The Brikar evolved on a high-gravity, tectonically active world, developing an incredibly dense, silicate-based epidermis. This natural rock-like skin provides exceptional resilience against physical impacts and extreme environmental pressures, allowing them to withstand conditions lethal to most other species.
trait_ruler_cube_focus_desc: This drone is intent on promoting the construction of Cubes.
trait_ruler_defensive_bias_desc: The construction of defensive fortifications is granted a much higher priority over other tasks.
trait_ruler_diamond_focus_desc: This drone is intent on promoting the construction of Diamonds.
trait_ruler_logistics_supercluster_desc: A massive organisational supercluster with requisition and predictive supply usage levels is in use by this leader. The usage of such a supercluster results in a much reduced supply cost for vessels and structures.
trait_ruler_offensive_bias_desc: The construction of offensive vessels is granted a much higher priority over other tasks.
trait_ruler_probe_focus_desc: This drone is intent on promoting the construction of Probes.
trait_ruler_resource_extraction_bias_des: The extraction of mineral resources for use by the Collective is of vital importance to this ruler.
trait_ruler_resource_nanite_bias_desc: The utilisation of nanites in expanding the influence of the Collective is of vital importance to this ruler.
trait_ruler_shapeshifter_desc: This species is capable of impersonating a wide variety of forms, but its natural state appears to be fluid.
trait_ruler_sphere_focus_desc: This drone is intent on promoting the construction of Spheres.
trait_shapeshifter_desc: This species is capable of impersonating a wide variety of forms, but its natural state appears to be fluid.
trait_short_lived_desc: These insectoids are born in great number, though few live beyond the first few weeks. They mature rapidly, but as a result are extremely short lived.
trait_silicon_desc: Silicon-based life-forms classified as intelligent. Their rock-like outer shell makes them highly resilient and long-lived, but their internal metabolism requires a great deal of external energy to be maintained. As such, they flourish only on planets rich in exotic types of radiation, such as hyperonic.
trait_skilled_administrator_desc: This species shows a high aptitude in managing complex projects and situations.
trait_skilled_hunters_desc: The advent of advanced farming technologies and nutrient replications has pushed most species to focus on the growth of flora. This species, however, still celebrate its roots and ancient traditions, and focus greatly on the practice of the hunt.
trait_sterile_desc: This species is unable to reproduce biologically and must find another way to propagate their number.
trait_structures_desc: Thanks to the unstable nature of this species's homeworld, the Tholians have become masters of adapting their world's nature to grow rather than build their dwellings and structures.
trait_stubborn_desc: This species is set in its ways has never been prone to change. New ideas, philosophies and concepts are slow to come, and are adopted even more slowly.
trait_supreme_biology_desc: This species have evolved to be the peak of biological evolution.
trait_survivor_talos_desc: All that is left of the once planet spanning civilisation that covered Talos. Surviving underground away from the aftermath of their war, they use their psionic powers to create wonderful and magnificent artificial habitats for themselves.
trait_symbiont_desc: This species has evolved in close symbiotic relations with a benign vermiform. The end result is a tightly-knit society that enjoys the benefit of both species.
trait_synaptic_processors_desc: At a young age, all members of this species are embedded with cybernetic brain enhancements that improve their processing capabilities, information storage and retrieval and pattern recognition.
trait_telepathy_desc:
A large portion of the population is capable of broad-range telepathic abilities, both receiving and sending messages. Many also carry a limited ability to sense emotions and even read minds, while a limited number even carry the ability to channel psychokinetic force.

Telepathic species are capable of unlocking the Psionic tech tree, that offers some risks but many rewards.
trait_the_phage_desc: This entire species has contracted a highly devastating bacteriophage virus that disrupts their genetic code and devours body tissue. The damage to the genome also makes reproduction a hazardous affair, to say the least, with a very high ratio of miscarriages and stillborn births.
trait_tosk_desc: This species is mostly used as hunting stock. Mostly.
trait_trill_biology_desc: One of the main neurotransmitters in the Trill brain is isoboramine giving the Trill a unique biological chemistry, capable of hosting two brains in one body, but also susceptible to a number of risks.
trait_trill_symbiont_desc: The Trill Symbionts are Vermiform lifeforms that can live in symbiosis with their host species. Living many decades and carrying vast knowledge it is a great honor to be chosen to carry a Symbiont.
trait_two_stomach_desc: Two stomachs allow a more resistant constitution than other species, as well as the ability to better resist poisons and toxins. You can also store latinum in one of them, if you want.
trait_untrustworthy_desc: Other species have heard tales of the underhanded ways of this species, which results in most species being less than trusting of them.
trait_vor_creativity_desc: Modifies the blockers in the Vorta cognitive processes to allow them more freedom to think... within reason.
trait_vor_green_thumb_desc: Enhancements to their senses allow for the Vorta to truly become one with nature.
trait_vor_lithe_desc: Adjustments to the genome allow for more flexible joints and eases the process of moving them to new places.
trait_vor_marsupial_cunning_desc: The Vorta were risen up from their marsupial form, but now have retained some of their animal cunning. Quick to learn, quick to obey.
trait_vor_optimised_desc: Improving the perfection in the Vorta clones allows for a higher resilience to disease and aging.
trait_vor_voice_founder_desc: Further tinkering with the genome has caused a genetic urge in the Vorta to obey the Founders, and to hang onto every word as if their life depends on it.
trait_xindi_desc: One of six related species to have independently evolved on the planet Xindus, each demonstrates considerable genetic overlap with the others.
